```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or

 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of

 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include <mutex>
#include <set>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#ifndef __riscv
#include <config.h>
#include <gum/gum.h>
#include <gum/guminterceptor.h>
#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#ifndef __riscv

namespace {

std::once_flag g_init_once;
GumInterceptor* g_interceptor = nullptr;
std::mutex g_mutex;
std::set<uintptr_t> g_hooked;

const char* replaceResultName(GumReplaceReturn result) {
  switch (result) {
    case GUM_REPLACE_OK:
      return "ok";
    case GUM_REPLACE_INVALID_INSTRUCTION:
      return "invalid instruction";
    case GUM_REPLACE_WRONG_SIGNATURE:
      return "wrong signature";
    case GUM_REPLACE_ALREADY_REPLACED:
      return "already replaced";
    case GUM_REPLACE_POLICY_VIOLATION:
      return "policy violation";
    case GUM_REPLACE_WRONG_TYPE:
      return "wrong type";
  }
  return "unknown error";
}

void initFridaGum() {
  gum_init_embedded();
  g_interceptor = gum_interceptor_obtain();
  if (g_interceptor) LOGI("frida-gum engine ready");
}

}  // namespace

bool fridaGumInit() {
  std::call_once(g_init_once, initFridaGum);
  if (!g_interceptor) {
    LOGE("frida-gum initialization failed");
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

bool fridaGumHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (!fridaGumInit()) return false;

  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  if (!g_hooked.insert(key).second) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: already hooked", target);
    return false;
  }

  const GumReplaceReturn result = gum_interceptor_replace(
      g_interceptor, target, replacement, original, nullptr);
  if (result != GUM_REPLACE_OK) {
    g_hooked.erase(key);
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: %s (%d)", target, replaceResultName(result),
         result);
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

bool fridaGumUnhook(void* target) {
  if (!fridaGumInit()) return false;

  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  const auto it = g_hooked.find(key);
  if (it == g_hooked.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed: not hooked", target);
    return false;
  }

  gum_interceptor_revert(g_interceptor, target);
  g_hooked.erase(it);
  return true;
}

#else

bool fridaGumInit() { return false; }

bool fridaGumHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)target;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

bool fridaGumUnhook(void* target) {
  (void)target;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <map>
#include <mutex>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#if defined(__aarch64__) || defined(__arm__) || defined(__x86_64__)
#include <hookzz.h>
#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#if defined(__aarch64__) || defined(__arm__) || defined(__x86_64__)

namespace {

#if defined(__aarch64__)
// ldr x17, #8; br x17; <address>
constexpr size_t kPatchBytes = 16;
#elif defined(__arm__)
// ldr pc, [pc, #-4]; <address>
constexpr size_t kPatchBytes = 8;
#else
// jmp qword ptr [rip]; <address>
constexpr size_t kPatchBytes = 14;
#endif

struct HookRecord {
  uint8_t backup[kPatchBytes];
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<uintptr_t, HookRecord> g_records;

bool makePatchWritable(void* target) {
  const long page_size = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
  if (page_size <= 0) return false;

  const uintptr_t align_mask = static_cast<uintptr_t>(page_size) - 1;
  const uintptr_t begin = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target) & ~align_mask;
  const uintptr_t end =
      (reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target) + kPatchBytes + align_mask) &
      ~align_mask;
  return mprotect(reinterpret_cast<void*>(begin), end - begin,
                  PROT_READ | PROT_WRITE | PROT_EXEC) == 0;
}

void flushPatch(void* target) {
  __builtin___clear_cache(reinterpret_cast<char*>(target),
                          reinterpret_cast<char*>(target) + kPatchBytes);
}

}  // namespace

bool hookzzHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (!target || !replacement) return false;

  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  if (g_records.find(key) != g_records.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: already hooked", target);
    return false;
  }

  HookRecord record{};
  memcpy(record.backup, target, kPatchBytes);

  void* relocated = nullptr;
  if (ZzReplace(target, replacement, &relocated) != RS_SUCCESS) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed", target);
    return false;
  }

  g_records.emplace(key, record);
  if (original) *original = relocated;
  return true;
}

bool hookzzUnhook(void* target) {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);

  const auto it = g_records.find(key);
  if (it == g_records.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed: not hooked", target);
    return false;
  }
  if (!makePatchWritable(target)) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed: the target is not writable", target);
    return false;
  }

  memcpy(target, it->second.backup, kPatchBytes);
  flushPatch(target);
  g_records.erase(it);
  return true;
}

#else

bool hookzzHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)target;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

bool hookzzUnhook(void* target) {
  (void)target;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
/*

#include <lsplt.hpp>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

namespace znn::hook::backend {
namespace {

struct Record {
  void* replacement = nullptr;
  void* original = nullptr;
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<std::string, Record> g_records;

std::string recordKey(dev_t dev, ino_t inode, const char* symbol) {
  std::string key = std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned long long>(dev));
  key += ':';
  key += std::to_string(static_cast<unsigned long long>(inode));
  key += '\x01';
  key += symbol;
  return key;
}

}  // namespace

bool lspltHook(dev_t dev, ino_t inode, const char* symbol, void* replacement,
               void** original) {
  const std::string key = recordKey(dev, inode, symbol);

  void* previous = nullptr;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
    if (auto it = g_records.find(key); it != g_records.end())
      previous = it->second.original;
  }

  void* backup = nullptr;
  if (previous) {
    if (replacement != previous) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: already hooked, unhook first", symbol);
      return false;
    }

    lsplt::RegisterHook(dev, inode, symbol, previous, &backup);
    const bool committed = lsplt::CommitHook();
    if (!backup) {
      if (!committed) {
        LOGE("pltHook %s: CommitHook failed", symbol);
      } else {
        LOGE("pltHook %s: symbol not found in PLT", symbol);
      }
      return false;
    }
    if (!committed) {
      LOGW("pltHook %s: the commit failed after the hook was removed", symbol);
    }
    {
      std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
      g_records.erase(key);
    }
    if (original) *original = previous;
    return true;
  }

  lsplt::RegisterHook(dev, inode, symbol, replacement, &backup);
  const bool committed = lsplt::CommitHook();
  if (!backup) {
    if (!committed) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: CommitHook failed", symbol);
    } else {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: symbol not found in PLT", symbol);
    }
    return false;
  }
  if (!committed) {
    LOGW("pltHook %s: the commit failed after the hook was installed", symbol);
  }
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
    g_records[key] = Record{replacement, backup};
  }
  if (original) *original = backup;
  return true;
}

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

`loader/src/hook/backend/plthook.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <cerrno>
#include <cstring>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#ifndef __riscv
#include <plthook.h>
#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#ifndef __riscv

namespace {

struct Slot {
  void** addr;
  void* previous;
  int prot;
};

struct Record {
  void* replacement;
  void* original;
  std::vector<Slot> slots;
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<std::string, Record> g_records;

std::string recordKey(const std::string& path, const char* symbol) {
  std::string key = path;
  key += '\x01';
  key += symbol;
  return key;
}

size_t pageSize() {
  static const size_t size = static_cast<size_t>(sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE));
  return size;
}

bool writeSlot(const Slot& slot, void* value) {
  auto* page = reinterpret_cast<void*>(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(slot.addr) &
                                       ~(pageSize() - 1));
  const bool restore = !(slot.prot & PROT_WRITE);
  if (restore && mprotect(page, pageSize(), slot.prot | PROT_WRITE) != 0) {
    LOGE("pltHook: mprotect %p to write failed: %s", page, strerror(errno));
    return false;
  }
  *slot.addr = value;
  if (restore && mprotect(page, pageSize(), slot.prot) != 0) {
    LOGE("pltHook: mprotect %p to restore failed: %s", page, strerror(errno));
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

bool symbolMatches(const char* name, const char* symbol, size_t length) {
  return strncmp(name, symbol, length) == 0 &&
         (name[length] == '\0' || name[length] == '@');
}

bool collectSlots(plthook_t* handle, const char* symbol,
                  std::vector<Slot>* slots) {
  const size_t length = strlen(symbol);
  unsigned int pos = 0;
  const char* name = nullptr;
  void** addr = nullptr;
  int prot = 0;
  int rv;
  while ((rv = plthook_enum_with_prot(handle, &pos, &name, &addr, &prot)) ==
         0) {
    if (!symbolMatches(name, symbol, length)) continue;
    if (!addr) continue;
    if (prot == 0) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: no memory protection for slot %p", symbol, addr);
      return false;
    }
    slots->push_back(Slot{addr, *addr, prot});
  }
  if (rv != EOF) {
    LOGE("pltHook %s: plthook_enum failed: %s", symbol, plthook_error());
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

bool openPlthook(const std::string& path, uintptr_t base, plthook_t** out) {
  if (base != 0 && plthook_open_by_address(
                       out, reinterpret_cast<void*>(base)) == PLTHOOK_SUCCESS) {
    return true;
  }
  if (!path.empty() && plthook_open(out, path.c_str()) == PLTHOOK_SUCCESS) {
    return true;
  }
  LOGE("pltHook: cannot open %s (base %p): %s", path.c_str(),
       reinterpret_cast<void*>(base), plthook_error());
  return false;
}

}  // namespace

bool plthookHook(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
                 const char* symbol, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (caller_path.empty() || !symbol || !replacement) return false;

  const std::string key = recordKey(caller_path, symbol);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);

  if (auto it = g_records.find(key); it != g_records.end()) {
    Record& record = it->second;
    if (replacement != record.original) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: %s is already hooked, unhook first", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str());
      return false;
    }
    size_t restored = 0;
    for (; restored < record.slots.size(); ++restored) {
      if (!writeSlot(record.slots[restored], record.slots[restored].previous)) {
        LOGE("pltHook %s: cannot restore slot in %s", symbol,
             caller_path.c_str());
        for (size_t i = 0; i < restored; ++i)
          writeSlot(record.slots[i], record.replacement);
        return false;
      }
    }
    void* const previous = record.original;
    g_records.erase(it);
    if (original) *original = previous;
    return true;
  }

  plthook_t* handle = nullptr;
  if (!openPlthook(caller_path, caller_base, &handle)) return false;

  std::vector<Slot> slots;
  const bool collected = collectSlots(handle, symbol, &slots);
  plthook_close(handle);
  if (!collected) return false;
  if (slots.empty()) {
    LOGE("pltHook %s: no matching relocation in %s", symbol,
         caller_path.c_str());
    return false;
  }

  size_t hooked = 0;
  for (; hooked < slots.size(); ++hooked) {
    if (!writeSlot(slots[hooked], replacement)) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: cannot hook slot in %s", symbol, caller_path.c_str());
      for (size_t i = 0; i < hooked; ++i)
        writeSlot(slots[i], slots[i].previous);
      return false;
    }
  }

  Record record{replacement, slots.front().previous, std::move(slots)};
  if (original) *original = record.original;
  g_records.emplace(key, std::move(record));
  return true;
}

#else

bool plthookHook(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
                 const char* symbol, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)caller_path;
  (void)caller_base;
  (void)symbol;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License

 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

extern "C" {
#include <plti.h>
}

namespace znn::hook::backend {
namespace {

struct Record {
  std::string path;
  std::string symbol;
  void* replacement = nullptr;
  void* original = nullptr;
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
bool g_initialized = false;
struct plti g_context;
std::map<std::string, Record> g_records;

std::string recordKey(const std::string& path, const char* symbol) {
  std::string key = path;
  key += '\x01';
  key += symbol;
  return key;
}

bool ensureContextLocked() {
  if (g_initialized) return true;
  if (!plti_init(&g_context)) {
    LOGE("pltHook: plti_init failed");
    return false;
  }
  g_initialized = true;
  return true;
}

bool addLibraryLocked(const std::string& path, uintptr_t base) {
  if (plti_add_manual_lib(&g_context, path.c_str(), base)) return true;
  LOGE("pltHook: no ELF image at %s (base %p)", path.c_str(),
       reinterpret_cast<void*>(base));
  return false;
}

}  // namespace

bool pltiHook(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
              const char* symbol, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (caller_path.empty() || !symbol || !replacement) return false;

  const std::string key = recordKey(caller_path, symbol);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  if (!ensureContextLocked()) return false;

  auto it = g_records.find(key);
  if (it != g_records.end()) {
    Record& rec = it->second;
    if (replacement != rec.original) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: %s is already hooked, unhook first", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str());
      return false;
    }
    void* restore = rec.original;
    if (!plti_remove_hook(&g_context, caller_path.c_str(), symbol, &restore)) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: plti_remove_hook failed for %s", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str());
      return false;
    }
    g_records.erase(it);
    if (original) *original = restore;
    return true;
  }

  if (!addLibraryLocked(caller_path, caller_base)) return false;

  void* backup = nullptr;
  if (!plti_add_hook(&g_context, caller_path.c_str(), symbol, replacement,
                     &backup)) {
    LOGE("pltHook %s: plti_add_hook failed for %s", symbol,
         caller_path.c_str());
    return false;
  }
  if (!backup) {
    LOGE("pltHook %s: no matching relocation in %s", symbol,
         caller_path.c_str());
    return false;
  }

  Record rec;
  rec.path = caller_path;
  rec.symbol = symbol;
  rec.replacement = replacement;
  rec.original = backup;
  g_records.emplace(key, std::move(rec));
  if (original) *original = backup;
  return true;
}

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.

 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
```

```cpp
#include <map>
#include <mutex>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#if defined(__aarch64__) || defined(__arm__)
#include <shadowhook.h>
#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#if defined(__aarch64__) || defined(__arm__)

namespace {

std::once_flag g_init_once;
int g_init_result = -1;
std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<uintptr_t, void*> g_stubs;

}  // namespace

bool shadowhookInit() {
  std::call_once(g_init_once, [] {
    g_init_result = shadowhook_init(SHADOWHOOK_MODE_UNIQUE, false);
  });
  if (g_init_result != 0) {
    LOGE("shadowhook_init failed: %s",
         shadowhook_to_errmsg(shadowhook_get_init_errno()));
    return false;
  }
  LOGI("shadowhook engine ready (mode: unique)");
  return true;
}

bool shadowhookHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (!shadowhookInit()) return false;
  void* stub = shadowhook_hook_func_addr(target, replacement, original);
  if (!stub) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: %s", target,
         shadowhook_to_errmsg(shadowhook_get_errno()));
    return false;
  }
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  g_stubs[reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target)] = stub;
  return true;
}

bool shadowhookUnhook(void* target) {
  if (!shadowhookInit()) return false;
  void* stub = nullptr;
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
    auto it = g_stubs.find(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target));
    if (it != g_stubs.end()) {
      stub = it->second;
    }
  }
  if (!stub || shadowhook_unhook(stub) != 0) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed", target);
    return false;
  }
  {
    std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
    g_stubs.erase(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target));
  }
  return true;
}

#else

bool shadowhookInit() { return false; }

bool shadowhookHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)target;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

bool shadowhookUnhook(void* target) {
  (void)target;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

`loader/src/hook/backend/urhook.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#if defined(__aarch64__)
#include <ur/capi.h>
#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#if defined(__aarch64__)

namespace {

struct InlineRecord {
  ur_inline_hook_t* handle = nullptr;
};

struct PltRecord {
  ur_plthook_t* handle = nullptr;
  void* original = nullptr;
};

std::mutex g_inline_mutex;
std::map<uintptr_t, InlineRecord> g_inline_records;

std::mutex g_plt_mutex;
std::map<std::string, PltRecord> g_plt_records;

std::string pltRecordKey(const std::string& caller_path, const char* symbol) {
  std::string key = caller_path;
  key += '\x01';
  key += symbol;
  return key;
}

bool openPltHandle(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
                   ur_plthook_t** out) {
  *out = nullptr;
  if (caller_base != 0 &&
      ur_plthook_create_from_base(caller_base, out) == UR_STATUS_OK && *out &&
      ur_plthook_is_valid(*out)) {
    return true;
  }
  if (*out) {
    ur_plthook_destroy(*out);
    *out = nullptr;
  }
  if (!caller_path.empty() &&
      ur_plthook_create_from_path(caller_path.c_str(), out) == UR_STATUS_OK &&
      *out && ur_plthook_is_valid(*out)) {
    return true;
  }
  if (*out) {
    ur_plthook_destroy(*out);
    *out = nullptr;
  }
  LOGE("pltHook: cannot parse %s (base %p)", caller_path.c_str(),
       reinterpret_cast<void*>(caller_base));
  return false;
}

}  // namespace

bool urhookHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (!target || !replacement) return false;

  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_inline_mutex);
  if (g_inline_records.find(key) != g_inline_records.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: already hooked", target);
    return false;
  }

  ur_inline_hook_t* handle = nullptr;
  if (ur_inline_hook_create(key, replacement, 1, &handle) != UR_STATUS_OK ||
      !handle) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed", target);
    return false;
  }

  void* trampoline = ur_inline_hook_get_trampoline(handle);
  if (!trampoline) {
    ur_inline_hook_destroy(handle);
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: no trampoline", target);
    return false;
  }

  g_inline_records.emplace(key, InlineRecord{handle});
  if (original) *original = trampoline;
  return true;
}

bool urhookUnhook(void* target) {
  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_inline_mutex);
  const auto it = g_inline_records.find(key);
  if (it == g_inline_records.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed: not hooked", target);
    return false;
  }
  ur_inline_hook_destroy(it->second.handle);
  g_inline_records.erase(it);
  return true;
}

bool urhookPltHook(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
                   const char* symbol, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (caller_path.empty() || !symbol || !replacement) return false;

  const std::string key = pltRecordKey(caller_path, symbol);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_plt_mutex);

  const auto it = g_plt_records.find(key);
  if (it != g_plt_records.end()) {
    PltRecord& record = it->second;
    if (replacement != record.original) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: %s is already hooked, unhook first", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str());
      return false;
    }
    if (ur_plthook_unhook_symbol(record.handle, symbol) != UR_STATUS_OK) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: cannot restore %s", symbol, caller_path.c_str());
      return false;
    }
    ur_plthook_destroy(record.handle);
    void* const previous = record.original;
    g_plt_records.erase(it);
    if (original) *original = previous;
    return true;
  }

  ur_plthook_t* handle = nullptr;
  if (!openPltHandle(caller_path, caller_base, &handle)) return false;

  void* backup = nullptr;
  if (ur_plthook_hook_symbol(handle, symbol, replacement, &backup) !=
      UR_STATUS_OK) {
    ur_plthook_destroy(handle);
    LOGE("pltHook %s: no matching relocation in %s", symbol,
         caller_path.c_str());
    return false;
  }

  g_plt_records.emplace(key, PltRecord{handle, backup});
  if (original) *original = backup;
  return true;
}

#else

bool urhookHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)target;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

bool urhookUnhook(void* target) {
  (void)target;
  return false;
}

bool urhookPltHook(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
                   const char* symbol, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)caller_path;
  (void)caller_base;
  (void)symbol;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
#include <map>

#include "log.h"

#ifndef __riscv
#include <znn_whale.h>

#ifndef __riscv

namespace {

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<uintptr_t, znn_whale_hook_t*> g_hooks;

}  // namespace

bool whaleHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (!target || !replacement) return false;

  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  if (g_hooks.find(key) != g_hooks.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: already hooked", target);
    return false;
  }

  void* trampoline = nullptr;
  znn_whale_hook_t* hook =
      znn_whale_hook_create(target, replacement, &trampoline);
  if (!hook) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed", target);
    return false;
  }

  g_hooks.emplace(key, hook);
  if (original) *original = trampoline;
  return true;
}

bool whaleUnhook(void* target) {
  const uintptr_t key = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  const auto it = g_hooks.find(key);
  if (it == g_hooks.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed: not hooked", target);
    return false;
  }
  znn_whale_hook_destroy(it->second);
  g_hooks.erase(it);
  return true;
}

#else

bool whaleHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)target;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
```

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include <map>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#ifndef __riscv
#include <xhook.h>
#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#ifndef __riscv

namespace {

struct Record {
  std::string path;
  std::string symbol;
  void* replacement = nullptr;
  void* original = nullptr;
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<std::string, Record> g_records;

std::string recordKey(const std::string& path, const char* symbol) {
  std::string key = path;
  key += '\x01';
  key += symbol;
  return key;
}

// caller library matched by regex
std::string anchorRegex(const std::string& path) {
  std::string regex = "^";
  regex.reserve(path.size() + 8);
  for (const char c : path) {
    switch (c) {
      case '.':
      case '\\':
      case '+':
      case '*':
      case '?':
      case '^':
      case '$':
      case '|':
      case '(':
      case ')':
      case '[':
      case ']':
      case '{':
      case '}':
        regex += '\\';
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
    regex += c;
  }
  regex += '$';
  return regex;
}

// caller holds g_mutex
bool commitLocked() {
  xhook_clear();
  for (auto& kv : g_records) {
    Record& rec = kv.second;
    const std::string regex = anchorRegex(rec.path);
    if (xhook_register(regex.c_str(), rec.symbol.c_str(), rec.replacement,
                       &rec.original) != 0) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: xhook_register failed", rec.symbol.c_str());
      return false;
    }
  }
  if (xhook_refresh(0) != 0) {
    LOGE("pltHook: xhook_refresh failed");
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

}  // namespace

bool xhookHook(const std::string& caller_path, const char* symbol,
               void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (caller_path.empty() || !symbol || !replacement) return false;

  const std::string key = recordKey(caller_path, symbol);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);
  auto it = g_records.find(key);
  if (it != g_records.end()) {
    Record& rec = it->second;
    if (replacement != rec.original) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: %s is already hooked, unhook first", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str());
      return false;
    }
    void* previous = rec.replacement;
    void* restore = rec.original;
    rec.replacement = restore;
    if (!commitLocked()) {
      rec.replacement = previous;
      return false;
    }
    g_records.erase(it);
    if (original) *original = restore;
    return true;
  }

  Record rec;
  rec.path = caller_path;
  rec.symbol = symbol;
  rec.replacement = replacement;
  rec.original = nullptr;
  auto inserted = g_records.emplace(key, std::move(rec)).first;

  if (!commitLocked() || inserted->second.original == nullptr) {
    g_records.erase(inserted);
    commitLocked();
    LOGE("pltHook %s: no matching relocation in %s", symbol,
         caller_path.c_str());
    return false;
  }
  if (original) *original = inserted->second.original;
  return true;
}

#else

bool xhookHook(const std::string& caller_path, const char* symbol,
               void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)caller_path;
  (void)symbol;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <cstdint>
#include <map>
#include <mutex>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#if defined(__aarch64__)
#include "inline_hook.hpp"

namespace {

constexpr size_t kMaxPatchSize = 64;

}  // namespace

extern "C" uint8_t yz_patch_text_checked(uintptr_t addr, const void* expected,
                                         const void* replacement,
                                         unsigned int len) {
  const size_t size = len;
  if (addr == 0 || !expected || !replacement || size == 0 ||
      size > kMaxPatchSize || addr > UINTPTR_MAX - size)
    return 0;
  if (memcmp(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(addr), expected, size) != 0)
    return 0;

  const int fd = open("/proc/self/mem", O_RDWR | O_CLOEXEC);
  if (fd < 0) {
    LOGE("inlineHook: cannot open /proc/self/mem to patch %p",
         reinterpret_cast<const void*>(addr));
    return 0;
  }

  const auto* bytes = static_cast<const uint8_t*>(replacement);
  size_t written = 0;
  while (written < size) {
    const ssize_t step = pwrite(fd, bytes + written, size - written,
                                static_cast<off_t>(addr + written));
    if (step < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
    if (step <= 0) {
      close(fd);
      LOGE("inlineHook: patching %p stopped after %zu of %zu byte(s)",
           reinterpret_cast<const void*>(addr), written, size);
      return written == 0 ? 0 : 2;
    }
    written += static_cast<size_t>(step);
  }
  close(fd);

  return memcmp(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(addr), replacement, size) == 0
             ? 1
             : 2;
}

#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#if defined(__aarch64__)

namespace {

constexpr size_t kPatchWindow = 8;

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<uintptr_t, yuki::ihook::Hook> g_records;

bool patchWindowFree(uintptr_t address) {
  for (const auto& entry : g_records) {
    const uintptr_t target = entry.first;
    if (!yuki::ihook::hook_ranges_overlap(address, kPatchWindow, target,
                                          kPatchWindow))
      continue;
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: it is inside the patch window of %p",
         reinterpret_cast<void*>(address), reinterpret_cast<void*>(target));
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

bool singleThreaded(const char* what, void* target) {
  if (yuki::ihook::single_threaded_process()) return true;
  LOGE("inline%s %p refused: this process has more than one thread", what,
       target);
  return false;
}

}  // namespace

bool yukiihookHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (!target || !replacement) return false;

  const uintptr_t address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);

  if (g_records.find(address) != g_records.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: already hooked", target);
    return false;
  }
  if (!patchWindowFree(address)) return false;
  if (!singleThreaded("Hook", target)) return false;

  yuki::ihook::Hook& hook = g_records[address];
  yuki::ihook::a64::Error reason = yuki::ihook::a64::Error::None;
  void* trampoline =
      yuki::ihook::install(target, replacement, &hook, false, false, &reason);
  if (!trampoline) {
    g_records.erase(address);
    LOGE("inlineHook %p failed: %s", target,
         yuki::ihook::a64::error_name(reason));
    return false;
  }

  if (original) *original = trampoline;
  return true;
}

bool yukiihookUnhook(void* target) {
  if (!target) return false;

  const uintptr_t address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(target);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);

  const auto it = g_records.find(address);
  if (it == g_records.end()) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed: not hooked", target);
    return false;
  }
  if (!singleThreaded("Unhook", target)) return false;

  if (!yuki::ihook::uninstall(&it->second)) {
    LOGE("inlineUnhook %p failed", target);
    return false;
  }
  g_records.erase(it);
  return true;
}

#else

bool yukiihookHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)target;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

bool yukiihookUnhook(void* target) {
  (void)target;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
#include <map>
#include <memory>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "log.h"

#ifndef __riscv
#include <yukiplt.h>
#endif

namespace znn::hook::backend {

#ifndef __riscv

namespace {

struct Record {
  yukiplt_c_handle handle{};
  std::unique_ptr<void*> original_storage;
  void* original = nullptr;
};

std::mutex g_mutex;
std::map<std::string, Record> g_records;

std::string recordKey(const std::string& caller_path, const char* symbol) {
  std::string key = caller_path;
  key += '\x01';
  key += symbol;
  return key;
}

bool findImage(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
               yukiplt_c_image* image) {
  const yukiplt_c_error by_address = yukiplt_c_image_containing(
      reinterpret_cast<const void*>(caller_base), image);
  if (by_address.code == YUKIPLT_C_SUCCESS) return true;
  const yukiplt_c_error by_name =
      yukiplt_c_image_from_soname(caller_path.c_str(), image);
  if (by_name.code == YUKIPLT_C_SUCCESS) return true;
  LOGE("pltHook: cannot find %s (base %p): %s / %s", caller_path.c_str(),
       reinterpret_cast<void*>(caller_base),
       yukiplt_c_error_name(by_address.code),
       yukiplt_c_error_name(by_name.code));
  return false;
}

yukiplt_c_error hookImage(const yukiplt_c_image& image,
                          const std::string& caller_path, const char* symbol,
                          void* replacement, void** original_storage,
                          yukiplt_c_handle* handle) {
  const yukiplt_c_selector selector = YUKIPLT_C_SELECTOR(symbol);
  yukiplt_c_slot_report report{};

  yukiplt_c_named_image named{};
  named.struct_size = sizeof(named);
  named.image = image;
  named.path = caller_path.c_str();

  const yukiplt_c_error named_error = yukiplt_c_hook_named(
      &named, &selector, replacement, original_storage, handle, &report);
  if (named_error.code != YUKIPLT_C_IMAGE_INVALIDATED) return named_error;
  return yukiplt_c_hook(&image, &selector, replacement, original_storage,
                        handle, &report);
}

}  // namespace

bool yukipltHook(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
                 const char* symbol, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (caller_path.empty() || !symbol || !replacement) return false;

  const std::string key = recordKey(caller_path, symbol);
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lk(g_mutex);

  if (const auto it = g_records.find(key); it != g_records.end()) {
    Record& record = it->second;
    if (replacement != record.original) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: %s is already hooked, unhook first", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str());
      return false;
    }
    const yukiplt_c_error error = yukiplt_c_unhook(&record.handle, nullptr, 0);
    if (error.code != YUKIPLT_C_SUCCESS &&
        error.code != YUKIPLT_C_IMAGE_INVALIDATED) {
      LOGE("pltHook %s: cannot restore slot in %s: %s", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str(), yukiplt_c_error_name(error.code));
      return false;
    }
    if (error.code == YUKIPLT_C_IMAGE_INVALIDATED)
      LOGW("pltHook %s: %s is no longer loaded, dropping the hook", symbol,
           caller_path.c_str());
    void* const previous = record.original;
    g_records.erase(it);
    if (original) *original = previous;
    return true;
  }

  yukiplt_c_image image{};
  if (!findImage(caller_path, caller_base, &image)) return false;

  auto storage = std::make_unique<void*>(nullptr);
  yukiplt_c_handle handle{};
  const yukiplt_c_error error = hookImage(image, caller_path, symbol,
                                          replacement, storage.get(), &handle);
  if (error.code != YUKIPLT_C_SUCCESS) {
    LOGE("pltHook %s in %s failed: %s", symbol, caller_path.c_str(),
         yukiplt_c_error_name(error.code));
    return false;
  }

  void* const resolved = yukiplt_c_load_original(storage.get());
  Record record;
  record.handle = handle;
  record.original = resolved;
  record.original_storage = std::move(storage);
  g_records.emplace(key, std::move(record));
  if (original) *original = resolved;
  return true;
}

#else

bool yukipltHook(const std::string& caller_path, uintptr_t caller_base,
                 const char* symbol, void* replacement, void** original) {
  (void)caller_path;
  (void)caller_base;
  (void)symbol;
  (void)replacement;
  (void)original;
  return false;
}

#endif

}  // namespace znn::hook::backend
```

```cpp
InlineEngine defaultInlineEngine() {
#ifdef __riscv
  return InlineEngine::kRv64Hook;
#else
  return InlineEngine::kDobby;
#endif
}

PltEngine defaultPltEngine() { return PltEngine::kLsplt; }

bool parseInlineEngine(const char* name, InlineEngine* out) {
  if (!name) return false;
  InlineEngine e;
  if (strcmp(name, "dobby") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kDobby;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "shadowhook") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kShadowHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "and64inlinehook") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kAnd64InlineHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "frida-gum") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kFridaGum;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "rv64hook") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kRv64Hook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "hookzz") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kHookZz;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "urhook") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kUrHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "whale") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kWhale;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "baaadhook") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kBaaadHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "yukiihook") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kYukiIhook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "disable") == 0) {
    e = InlineEngine::kDisable;
  } else {
    return false;
  }
  if (!inlineEngineSupported(e)) return false;
  *out = e;
  return true;
}

bool parsePltEngine(const char* name, PltEngine* out) {
  if (!name) return false;
  PltEngine e;
  if (strcmp(name, "lsplt") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kLsplt;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "bytehook") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kByteHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "xhook") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kXHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "plti") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kPlti;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "plthook") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kPltHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "urhook") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kUrHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "baaadhook") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kBaaadHook;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "yukiplt") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kYukiPlt;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "disable") == 0) {
    e = PltEngine::kDisable;
  } else {
    return false;
  }
  if (!pltEngineSupported(e)) return false;
  *out = e;
  return true;
}

InlineEngine inlineEngine() { return g_inline_engine; }

PltEngine pltEngine() { return g_plt_engine; }

void setInlineEngine(InlineEngine e) {
  if (inlineEngineSupported(e)) g_inline_engine = e;
}

void setPltEngine(PltEngine e) {
  if (pltEngineSupported(e)) g_plt_engine = e;
}

void ensureInlineEngineReady() {
  bool ready = true;
  switch (g_inline_engine) {
    case InlineEngine::kShadowHook:
      ready = backend::shadowhookInit();
      break;
    case InlineEngine::kAnd64InlineHook:
      ready = backend::and64inlinehookInit();
      break;
    case InlineEngine::kFridaGum:
      ready = backend::fridaGumInit();
      break;
    default:
      return;
  }
  if (ready) return;

  const InlineEngine fallback = defaultInlineEngine();
  LOGE("%s unavailable in pid %d, falling back to inline=%s for this process",
       inlineEngineName(g_inline_engine), getpid(), inlineEngineName(fallback));
  g_inline_engine = fallback;
}

void ensurePltEngineReady() {
  bool ready = true;
  switch (g_plt_engine) {
    case PltEngine::kByteHook:
      ready = backend::bytehookInit();
      break;
    default:
      return;
  }
  if (ready) return;

  const PltEngine fallback = defaultPltEngine();
  LOGE("%s unavailable in pid %d, falling back to plt=%s for this process",
       pltEngineName(g_plt_engine), getpid(), pltEngineName(fallback));
  g_plt_engine = fallback;
}

}  // namespace znn::hook
```

```cpp
bool inlineHook(void* target, void* replacement, void** original) {
  if (!target || !replacement) return false;
  ensureInlineEngineReady();
  switch (inlineEngine()) {
    case InlineEngine::kDobby:
      return backend::dobbyHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kShadowHook:
      return backend::shadowhookHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kAnd64InlineHook:
      return backend::and64inlinehookHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kFridaGum:
      return backend::fridaGumHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kRv64Hook:
      return backend::rv64hookHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kHookZz:
      return backend::hookzzHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kUrHook:
      return backend::urhookHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kWhale:
      return backend::whaleHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kBaaadHook:
      return backend::baaadhookHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kYukiIhook:
      return backend::yukiihookHook(target, replacement, original);
    case InlineEngine::kDisable:
      return false;
  }
  return false;
}

bool inlineUnhook(void* target) {
  if (!target) return false;
  ensureInlineEngineReady();
  switch (inlineEngine()) {
    case InlineEngine::kDobby:
      return backend::dobbyUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kShadowHook:
      return backend::shadowhookUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kAnd64InlineHook:
      return backend::and64inlinehookUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kFridaGum:
      return backend::fridaGumUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kRv64Hook:
      return backend::rv64hookUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kHookZz:
      return backend::hookzzUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kUrHook:
      return backend::urhookUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kWhale:
      return backend::whaleUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kBaaadHook:
      return backend::baaadhookUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kYukiIhook:
      return backend::yukiihookUnhook(target);
    case InlineEngine::kDisable:
      return false;
  }
  return false;
}

}  // namespace znn::hook
```

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "hook/plt.h"

#include <sys/mman.h>

#include <vector>

#include "hook/backend.h"
#include "hook/engine.h"
#include "log.h"
#include "utils/elf_util.h"

namespace znn::hook {
namespace {

const MapEntry* findMapping(const std::vector<MapEntry>& maps, uintptr_t base) {
  for (const auto& m : maps) {
    if (m.inode == 0) continue;
    if (base >= m.start && base < m.end) return &m;
    if (m.start >= m.offset && base == m.start - m.offset) return &m;
  }
  return nullptr;
}

const MapEntry* firstMappingOfFile(const std::vector<MapEntry>& maps,
                                   const MapEntry& hit) {
  if (hit.start < hit.offset) return &hit;
  const uintptr_t load_base = hit.start - hit.offset;
  const MapEntry* first_readable = nullptr;
  for (const auto& m : maps) {
    if (m.dev != hit.dev || m.inode != hit.inode) continue;
    if (m.start < m.offset || m.start - m.offset != load_base) continue;
    if (!(m.perms & PROT_READ)) continue;
    if (m.offset == 0) return &m;
    if (!first_readable) first_readable = &m;
  }
  return first_readable ? first_readable : &hit;
}

}  // namespace

bool pltHook(void* base, const char* symbol, void* replacement,
             void** original) {
  if (!base || !symbol || !replacement) return false;
  ensurePltEngineReady();

  const uintptr_t b = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(base);
  const auto maps = parseMaps("self");
  const MapEntry* hit = findMapping(maps, b);
  if (!hit) {
    LOGE("pltHook %s: base %p not found in maps", symbol, base);
    return false;
  }
  const MapEntry* entry = firstMappingOfFile(maps, *hit);
  if (entry->path.empty()) {
    LOGE("pltHook %s: base %p has no path in maps", symbol, base);
    return false;
  }
  LOGI("pltHook base=%p symbol=%s path=%s dev=%llu inode=%llu", base, symbol,
       entry->path.c_str(), static_cast<unsigned long long>(entry->dev),
       static_cast<unsigned long long>(entry->inode));

  switch (pltEngine()) {
    case PltEngine::kLsplt:
      return backend::lspltHook(entry->dev, entry->inode, symbol, replacement,
                                original);
    case PltEngine::kByteHook:
      return backend::bytehookHook(entry->path, symbol, replacement, original);
    case PltEngine::kXHook:
      return backend::xhookHook(entry->path, symbol, replacement, original);
    case PltEngine::kPlti:
      return backend::pltiHook(entry->path, entry->start, symbol, replacement,
                               original);
    case PltEngine::kPltHook:
      return backend::plthookHook(entry->path, entry->start, symbol,
                                  replacement, original);
    case PltEngine::kUrHook:
      return backend::urhookPltHook(entry->path, entry->start, symbol,
                                    replacement, original);
    case PltEngine::kBaaadHook:
      return backend::baaadhookPltHook(entry->path, symbol, replacement,
                                       original);
    case PltEngine::kYukiPlt:
      return backend::yukipltHook(entry->path, entry->start, symbol,
                                  replacement, original);
    case PltEngine::kDisable:
      return false;
  }
  return false;
}

}  // namespace znn::hook
```

`loader/src/hyos/hooks.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "hyos/hooks.h"

#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <pthread.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "api/api.h"
#include "hook/inline.h"
#include "hook/plt.h"
#include "hyos/runtime.h"
#include "hyos/state.h"
#include "log.h"
#include "utils/elf_util.h"

namespace znn::hyos {
namespace {

bool g_reinstall = false;

// spawner image, offset-0 mapping
void findSpawnerImage() {
  State& s = state();
  if (s.spawner.inode != 0) return;
  for (const auto& m : parseMaps("self")) {
    if (m.offset != 0 || m.inode == 0) continue;
    if (m.path.find("hyos_spawner") == std::string::npos) continue;
    s.spawner.dev = m.dev;
    s.spawner.inode = m.inode;
    s.spawner.base = m.start;
    LOGI("HYOS: spawner image dev=%llu inode=%llu base=%p",
         static_cast<unsigned long long>(m.dev),
         static_cast<unsigned long long>(m.inode),
         reinterpret_cast<void*>(m.start));
    break;
  }
}

int setcontextHook(uid_t uid, int is_system_server, const char* se_info,
                   const char* pkg_name) {
  State& s = state();
  int ret = s.orig_setcontext
                ? s.orig_setcontext(uid, is_system_server, se_info, pkg_name)
                : -1;
  if (ret == 0) {
    deliverAppSpecialized(pkg_name, se_info);
  } else if (!s.fired && s.in_child) {
    LOGW("HYOS: selinux_android_setcontext failed (%d)", ret);
  }
  return ret;
}

int setnameHook(pthread_t thread, const char* name) {
  State& s = state();
  int ret = s.orig_setname ? s.orig_setname(thread, name) : -1;
  if (ret == 0 && s.in_child && !s.fired.load(std::memory_order_relaxed) &&
      thread == pthread_self() && name && name[0] != '\0') {
    int expected = kNameEmpty;
    if (s.name_state.compare_exchange_strong(expected, kNameWriting,
                                             std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                             std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
      strlcpy(s.captured_name, name, sizeof(s.captured_name));
      s.name_state.store(kNameReady, std::memory_order_release);
      LOGI("HYOS: captured process name %s", s.captured_name);
    }
  }
  return ret;
}

pid_t forkHook() {
  State& s = state();
  pid_t res = s.orig_fork ? s.orig_fork() : -1;
  if (res == 0) {
    atForkChild();
  } else if (res > 0 && g_reinstall) {
    g_reinstall = false;
    if (!s.in_child) {
      installHooks();
    }
  }
  return res;
}

}  // namespace

// no allocation here
void atForkChild() {
  State& s = state();
  s.in_child = true;
  s.fired.store(false, std::memory_order_relaxed);
  s.captured_name[0] = '\0';
  s.name_state.store(kNameEmpty, std::memory_order_release);
  g_reinstall = false;
}

void atForkPrepare() {
  State& s = state();
  if (!s.in_child && s.module_count > 0 &&
      (!s.orig_setcontext || !s.orig_setname)) {
    g_reinstall = true;
  }
}

void installHooks() {
  State& s = state();
  findSpawnerImage();

  if (s.spawner.inode != 0 && !s.plt_fork_tried) {
    if (s.orig_fork) {
      s.plt_fork_tried = true;
    } else {
      void* backup = nullptr;
      if (hook::pltHook(reinterpret_cast<void*>(s.spawner.base), "fork",
                        reinterpret_cast<void*>(forkHook), &backup)) {
        s.orig_fork = reinterpret_cast<ForkFn>(backup);
        s.plt_fork_tried = true;
        LOGI("HYOS: PLT hooked fork");
      } else {
        LOGW("HYOS: cannot hook fork, app specialization will not fire");
      }
    }
  }
  if (s.spawner.inode != 0 && !s.plt_ctx_tried) {
    if (s.orig_setcontext) {
      s.plt_ctx_tried = true;
    } else {
      void* backup = nullptr;
      if (hook::pltHook(reinterpret_cast<void*>(s.spawner.base),
                        "selinux_android_setcontext",
                        reinterpret_cast<void*>(setcontextHook), &backup)) {
        s.orig_setcontext = reinterpret_cast<SetcontextFn>(backup);
        s.plt_ctx_tried = true;
        LOGI("HYOS: PLT hooked selinux_android_setcontext");
      }
    }
  }

  if (!s.orig_setcontext) {
    void* fn = dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "selinux_android_setcontext");
    if (!fn) {
      void* h = dlopen("libselinux.so", RTLD_NOW);
      if (h) fn = dlsym(h, "selinux_android_setcontext");
    }
    if (fn && api::inlineHook(fn, reinterpret_cast<void*>(setcontextHook),
                              reinterpret_cast<void**>(&s.orig_setcontext)) ==
                  ZN_SUCCESS) {
      LOGI("HYOS: inline hooked selinux_android_setcontext");
    } else if (fn) {
      LOGW("HYOS: cannot inline hook selinux_android_setcontext");
    }
  }
  if (!s.orig_setname) {
    void* fn = dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "pthread_setname_np");
    if (!fn) {
      void* h = dlopen("libc.so", RTLD_NOW);
      if (h) fn = dlsym(h, "pthread_setname_np");
    }
    if (fn && api::inlineHook(fn, reinterpret_cast<void*>(setnameHook),
                              reinterpret_cast<void**>(&s.orig_setname)) ==
                  ZN_SUCCESS) {
      LOGI("HYOS: inline hooked pthread_setname_np");
    } else if (fn) {
      LOGW("HYOS: cannot inline hook pthread_setname_np");
    }
  }
  if (!s.orig_setcontext && !s.warned) {
    s.warned = true;
    LOGW(
        "HYOS: selinux_android_setcontext not available, onAppSpecialized will "
        "not fire");
  }
}

}  // namespace znn::hyos
```

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "hyos/runtime.h"

#include <pthread.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/prctl.h>

#include "hyos/hooks.h"
#include "hyos/state.h"
#include "log.h"

namespace znn::hyos {
namespace {

const ZygiskNextRuntime kRuntime = {
    .type = ZN_RUNTIME_HYOS,
    .api_version = ZYGISK_NEXT_HYOS_API_VERSION,
    .registerModule = registerModule,
};

}  // namespace

bool active() { return state().active; }

void setActive(bool value) { state().active = value; }

void deliverAppSpecialized(const char* pkg_name, const char* se_info) {
  State& s = state();
  if (!s.in_child || s.module_count == 0) return;
  bool expected = false;
  if (!s.fired.compare_exchange_strong(expected, true,
                                       std::memory_order_acq_rel,
                                       std::memory_order_relaxed)) {
    return;
  }

  static char process_name[256];
  static char package_name[256];
  static char se_info_buf[64];

  if (s.name_state.load(std::memory_order_acquire) == kNameReady) {
    strlcpy(process_name, s.captured_name, sizeof(process_name));
  } else {
    // fallback
    process_name[0] = '\0';
    if (prctl(PR_GET_NAME, process_name, 0, 0, 0) != 0 ||
        process_name[0] == '\0') {
      strlcpy(process_name, "hyos_app", sizeof(process_name));
    }
  }
  strlcpy(package_name, pkg_name ? pkg_name : "", sizeof(package_name));
  strlcpy(se_info_buf, se_info ? se_info : "", sizeof(se_info_buf));

  ZnHyosAppSpecializeArgs args = {process_name, package_name, se_info_buf};
  LOGI("HYOS app specialized: process=%s package=%s se_info=%s", process_name,
       package_name, se_info_buf);
  for (int i = 0; i < s.module_count; ++i) {
    if (s.modules[i].onAppSpecialized) {
      s.modules[i].onAppSpecialized(&args);
    }
  }
}

int registerModule(const void* module) {
  if (!module) return ZN_FAILED;
  const auto* m = static_cast<const ZygiskNextHyosModule*>(module);
  if (!m->onAppSpecialized) return ZN_FAILED;
  if (m->target_api_version > ZYGISK_NEXT_HYOS_API_VERSION) {
    LOGE("HYOS: module targets API version %d, only up to %d supported",
         m->target_api_version, ZYGISK_NEXT_HYOS_API_VERSION);
    return ZN_FAILED;
  }
  State& s = state();
  if (s.module_count >= kMaxModules) {
    LOGE("HYOS: too many modules registered (max %d)", kMaxModules);
    return ZN_FAILED;
  }
  s.modules[s.module_count++] = *m;

  if (!s.in_child) {
    pthread_atfork(atForkPrepare, nullptr, atForkChild);
  }
  installHooks();
  LOGI("HYOS: module registered (%d)", s.module_count);
  return ZN_SUCCESS;
}

const ZygiskNextRuntime* runtime() { return &kRuntime; }

}  // namespace znn::hyos
```

`loader/src/include/zygisk_next_api.h`:

```h
#pragma once

#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdbool.h>
#include <stddef.h>

#ifdef __cplusplus
extern "C" {
#endif

#define ZYGISK_NEXT_API_VERSION 4
#define ZYGISK_NEXT_HYOS_API_VERSION 1

#define ZN_SUCCESS 0
#define ZN_FAILED 1

struct ZnSymbolResolver;
struct ZygiskNextRuntime;

struct ZygiskNextAPI {
  // Hook API

  // Do plt hook at symbol specified by the param `symbol` of library
  // specified by the param `base_addr` The plt address of `symbol` in the
  // library will be replaced with hook_handler, and its original value will
  // be put to the address specified by `original` (can be null). You can use
  // this api to do caller-oriented hook If you want to unhook, please call
  // this function with hook_handler = original If hook succeed, returns
  // ZN_SUCCESS, otherwise ZN_FAILED
  int (*pltHook)(void* base_addr, const char* symbol, void* hook_handler,
                 void** original);

  // Do inline hook at the address specified by `target`, replace it with a
  // new function specified by `addr`, and the param `original` receives the
  // address of original function. You can use this api to achieve a global
  // hook in current process. In the current implementation , an address can
  // only hook once, so the module can't hook an address which is already
  // hooked by an another module, except that the module unhooked it. If
  // hooking succeed, returns ZN_SUCCESS, otherwise ZN_FAILED
  int (*inlineHook)(void* target, void* addr, void** original);

  // Unhook the address which is formerly hooked.
  // If hook succeed, returns ZN_SUCCESS, otherwise ZN_FAILED
  int (*inlineUnhook)(void* target);

  // Symbol Resolver API

  // Obtain a new ZnSymbolResolver object
  // `path` is required, which specifies the path of library to resolve. It
  // can be an absolute path or just the file name of library, e.g.
  // /system/lib64/libc.so or libc.so . If `base_addr` is non-zero, it will be
  // used as the base address of the library. Otherwise, Zygisk Next will try
  // to find out the base address of the specified library in this process. If
  // succeed, it returns a valid pointer to the symbol resolver, otherwise
  // nullptr is returned.
  struct ZnSymbolResolver* (*newSymbolResolver)(const char* path,
                                                void* base_addr);

  // Release the ZnSymbolResolver object pointed by `resolver`.
  void (*freeSymbolResolver)(struct ZnSymbolResolver* resolver);

  // Retrieve the base address of the library of the resolver image in the
  // process.
  void* (*getBaseAddress)(struct ZnSymbolResolver* resolver);

  // Lookup the address of symbol by name or prefix (if `prefix` is true)
  // If the symbol exists, the function returns its address, otherwise returns
  // nullptr. If `size` is not nullptr, the size of the symbol will be put to
  // *size . In the current implementation, gnu_debugdata resolution is
  // supported.
  void* (*symbolLookup)(struct ZnSymbolResolver* resolver, const char* name,
                        bool prefix, size_t* size);

  // Walk through the symbol table of the library, the callback will receive
  // the name, the address, and the size of each symbol. Returning false in
  // the callback means stop the walking.
  void (*forEachSymbols)(struct ZnSymbolResolver* resolver,
                         bool (*callback)(const char* name, void* addr,
                                          size_t size, void* data),
                         void* data);

  // Companion API

  // Create a unix sock stream connection to your declared companion process.
  // The value of `handle` is the `self_handle` which you've received from
  // onModuleLoaded. On success, it returns the file descriptor refer to the
  // socket, otherwise -1 is returned. Please close this file descriptor by
  // yourself.
  int (*connectCompanion)(void* handle);

  // Return the runtime-specific API for the current process, or null if the
  // process does not expose a supported runtime. The returned object remains
  // valid for the lifetime of the process. Inspect its type before passing a
  // runtime-specific module structure to registerModule.
  const struct ZygiskNextRuntime* (*getRuntime)(void);
};

// Callbacks of an injected library
struct ZygiskNextModule {
  // Please fill this with the target version of your module, e.g.
  // ZYGISK_NEXT_API_VERSION
  int target_api_version;

  // This callback will be called after all needed library of the main
  // executable are loaded, and before the entry (i.e. `main`) of the main
  // executable is called.
  void (*onModuleLoaded)(void* self_handle, const struct ZygiskNextAPI* api);
};

enum ZygiskNextRuntimeType {
  ZN_RUNTIME_HYOS = 1,
};

// Read-only process specialization information for applications forked by
// /system_ext/bin/hyos_spawner. The callback runs after the uid, gid,
// supplementary groups, and SELinux app context have been applied. The string
// pointers are non-null and only valid for the duration of the callback.
struct ZnHyosAppSpecializeArgs {
  const char* process_name;
  const char* package_name;
  const char* se_info;
};

// HyperOS Rust Runtime callbacks registered through
// ZygiskNextRuntime.registerModule.
struct ZygiskNextHyosModule {
  int target_api_version;
  void (*onAppSpecialized)(const struct ZnHyosAppSpecializeArgs* args);
};

// Runtime-specific API returned by getRuntime. The module structure accepted
// by registerModule is selected by type. The runtime copies the structure
// before registerModule returns.
struct ZygiskNextRuntime {
  enum ZygiskNextRuntimeType type;
  int api_version;
  int (*registerModule)(const void* module);
};

// Callbacks of a companion library
struct ZygiskNextCompanionModule {
  int target_api_version;

  void (*onCompanionLoaded)();

  // This callback will be called when your Zygisk Next module is trying to
  // establish a connection with your companion module, i.e.
  // `connectCompanion` is called. The `fd` param will be a unix sock stream
  // file descriptor. Please close this file descriptor after use by yourself.
  void (*onModuleConnected)(int fd);
};

// Please define your `zn_module` in your source file.
extern __attribute__((visibility("default"),
                      unused)) struct ZygiskNextModule zn_module;
extern __attribute__((
    visibility("default"),
    unused)) struct ZygiskNextCompanionModule zn_companion_module;

#ifdef __cplusplus
}
#endif
```

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "ipc/channel.h"

#include <errno.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <poll.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/socket.h>
#include <sys/un.h>
#include <time.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "ipc/plan.h"
#include "log.h"

namespace znn::ipc {
namespace {

constexpr int kNonceBytes = 4;

void closeFd(int fd) {
  if (fd >= 0) close(fd);
}

bool isRootPeer(int fd) {
  struct ucred peer{};
  socklen_t size = sizeof(peer);
  if (getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_PEERCRED, &peer, &size) != 0) return false;
  if (peer.uid != 0) {
    LOGW("companion channel: rejected peer uid %u",
         static_cast<unsigned>(peer.uid));
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

bool waitReadable(int fd, int timeout_ms) {
  struct pollfd pfd{};
  pfd.fd = fd;
  pfd.events = POLLIN;
  for (;;) {
    const int rc = poll(&pfd, 1, timeout_ms);
    if (rc > 0) return true;
    if (rc < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
    return false;
  }
}

}  // namespace

size_t channelName(uint32_t nonce, uint32_t index, char* out) {
  out[0] = '\0';
  const int written =
      snprintf(out + 1, kChannelNameMax - 1, "znn.%08x.%u", nonce, index);
  if (written <= 0) return 1;
  return static_cast<size_t>(written) + 1;
}

size_t directChannelName(uint32_t nonce, uint32_t index, char* out) {
  out[0] = '\0';
  const int written =
      snprintf(out + 1, kChannelNameMax - 1, "znn.c.%08x.%u", nonce, index);
  if (written <= 0) return 1;
  return static_cast<size_t>(written) + 1;
}

bool channelUsable(int fd) {
  if (fd < 0) return false;
  if (fcntl(fd, F_GETFD) < 0) return false;
  int type = 0;
  socklen_t length = sizeof(type);
  if (getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_TYPE, &type, &length) != 0) return false;
  if (type != SOCK_STREAM) return false;
  int accepting = 0;
  length = sizeof(accepting);
  if (getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ACCEPTCONN, &accepting, &length) != 0)
    return false;
  if (accepting != 0) return false;
  struct ucred peer{};
  length = sizeof(peer);
  if (getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_PEERCRED, &peer, &length) != 0)
    return false;
  return peer.uid == 0;
}

bool listenerUsable(int fd) {
  if (fd < 0) return false;
  if (fcntl(fd, F_GETFD) < 0) return false;
  int type = 0;
  socklen_t length = sizeof(type);
  if (getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_TYPE, &type, &length) != 0) return false;
  if (type != SOCK_STREAM) return false;
  int accepting = 0;
  length = sizeof(accepting);
  if (getsockopt(fd, SOL_SOCKET, SO_ACCEPTCONN, &accepting, &length) != 0)
    return false;
  return accepting != 0;
}

int connectCompanionChannel(uint32_t nonce, uint32_t index,
                            const uint8_t* token) {
  const int fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
  if (fd < 0) {
    LOGW("companion: direct socket failed: %s", strerror(errno));
    return -1;
  }

  struct sockaddr_un addr{};
  addr.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
  const size_t name_len = directChannelName(nonce, index, addr.sun_path);
  const socklen_t addr_len =
      static_cast<socklen_t>(offsetof(struct sockaddr_un, sun_path) + name_len);
  if (connect(fd, reinterpret_cast<struct sockaddr*>(&addr), addr_len) != 0) {
    LOGW("companion: cannot reach the direct channel: %s", strerror(errno));
    close(fd);
    return -1;
  }

  if (token) {
    size_t off = 0;
    while (off < kCompanionTokenBytes) {
      const ssize_t n =
          send(fd, token + off, kCompanionTokenBytes - off, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
      if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
      if (n <= 0) {
        LOGW("companion: cannot prove the direct channel: %s", strerror(errno));
        close(fd);
        return -1;
      }
      off += static_cast<size_t>(n);
    }
  }
  return fd;
}

int bindChannel(uint32_t nonce, uint32_t index) {
  const int fd = socket(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0);
  if (fd < 0) {
    LOGE("companion channel %u: socket failed: %s", index, strerror(errno));
    return -1;
  }

  struct sockaddr_un addr{};
  addr.sun_family = AF_UNIX;
  const size_t name_len = channelName(nonce, index, addr.sun_path);
  const socklen_t addr_len =
      static_cast<socklen_t>(offsetof(struct sockaddr_un, sun_path) + name_len);
  if (bind(fd, reinterpret_cast<struct sockaddr*>(&addr), addr_len) != 0) {
    LOGE("companion channel %u: bind failed: %s", index, strerror(errno));
    close(fd);
    return -1;
  }
  if (listen(fd, kChannelBacklog) != 0) {
    LOGE("companion channel %u: listen failed: %s", index, strerror(errno));
    close(fd);
    return -1;
  }
  return fd;
}

int acceptChannel(int listen_fd, uint32_t nonce, int timeout_ms) {
  if (listen_fd < 0) return -1;
  if (!waitReadable(listen_fd, timeout_ms)) {
    LOGW("companion channel: no helper connected within %d ms", timeout_ms);
    return -1;
  }

  const int fd = accept4(listen_fd, nullptr, nullptr, SOCK_CLOEXEC);
  if (fd < 0) {
    LOGW("companion channel: accept failed: %s", strerror(errno));
    return -1;
  }
  if (!isRootPeer(fd)) {
    close(fd);
    return -1;
  }

  uint8_t proof[kNonceBytes] = {};
  struct timespec deadline{};
  clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &deadline);
  deadline.tv_sec += kChannelAcceptTimeoutMs / 1000;
  deadline.tv_nsec +=
      static_cast<long>(kChannelAcceptTimeoutMs % 1000) * 1000000L;
  if (deadline.tv_nsec >= 1000000000L) {
    deadline.tv_sec += 1;
    deadline.tv_nsec -= 1000000000L;
  }
  size_t off = 0;
  while (off < sizeof(proof)) {
    struct timespec now{};
    clock_gettime(CLOCK_MONOTONIC, &now);
    const long remaining_ms = (deadline.tv_sec - now.tv_sec) * 1000L +
                              (deadline.tv_nsec - now.tv_nsec) / 1000000L;
    if (!waitReadable(fd,
                      remaining_ms > 0 ? static_cast<int>(remaining_ms) : 0)) {
      LOGW("companion channel: helper did not send its nonce");
      close(fd);
      return -1;
    }
    const ssize_t n = read(fd, proof + off, sizeof(proof) - off);
    if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
    if (n <= 0) {
      LOGW("companion channel: cannot read the nonce: %s", strerror(errno));
      close(fd);
      return -1;
    }
    off += static_cast<size_t>(n);
  }
  if (memcmp(proof, &nonce, sizeof(proof)) != 0) {
    LOGW("companion channel: nonce mismatch, dropping the connection");
    close(fd);
    return -1;
  }
  return fd;
}

bool makePeerPair(int* out_module_fd, int* out_helper_fd) {
  int sv[2] = {-1, -1};
  if (socketpair(AF_UNIX, SOCK_STREAM | SOCK_CLOEXEC, 0, sv) != 0) {
    LOGW("companion: socketpair failed: %s", strerror(errno));
    return false;
  }
  *out_module_fd = sv[0];
  *out_helper_fd = sv[1];
  return true;
}

bool sendFrame(int fd, uint8_t command, int payload_fd) {
  struct iovec iov{};
  iov.iov_base = &command;
  iov.iov_len = sizeof(command);

  char cmsg_buf[CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int))] = {};
  struct msghdr msg{};
  msg.msg_iov = &iov;
  msg.msg_iovlen = 1;
  if (payload_fd >= 0) {
    msg.msg_control = cmsg_buf;
    msg.msg_controllen = sizeof(cmsg_buf);
    struct cmsghdr* cmsg = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&msg);
    cmsg->cmsg_level = SOL_SOCKET;
    cmsg->cmsg_type = SCM_RIGHTS;
    cmsg->cmsg_len = CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int));
    memcpy(CMSG_DATA(cmsg), &payload_fd, sizeof(int));
    msg.msg_controllen = cmsg->cmsg_len;
  }

  for (;;) {
    const ssize_t n = sendmsg(fd, &msg, MSG_NOSIGNAL);
    if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
    return n > 0;
  }
}

bool recvFrame(int fd, uint8_t* command, int* out_fd) {
  char cmsg_buf[CMSG_SPACE(sizeof(int))] = {};
  struct iovec iov{};
  iov.iov_base = command;
  iov.iov_len = sizeof(*command);
  struct msghdr msg{};
  msg.msg_iov = &iov;
  msg.msg_iovlen = 1;
  msg.msg_control = cmsg_buf;
  msg.msg_controllen = sizeof(cmsg_buf);

  ssize_t n;
  for (;;) {
    n = recvmsg(fd, &msg, 0);
    if (n < 0 && errno == EINTR) continue;
    break;
  }
  if (n <= 0) return false;

  int received = -1;
  for (struct cmsghdr* c = CMSG_FIRSTHDR(&msg); c; c = CMSG_NXTHDR(&msg, c)) {
    if (c->cmsg_level != SOL_SOCKET || c->cmsg_type != SCM_RIGHTS) continue;
    if (c->cmsg_len < CMSG_LEN(sizeof(int))) continue;
    memcpy(&received, CMSG_DATA(c), sizeof(int));
    break;
  }
  if (out_fd)
    *out_fd = received;
  else
    closeFd(received);
  return true;
}

}  // namespace znn::ipc
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <stddef.h>
#include <stdint.h>

namespace znn::ipc {

constexpr uint32_t kPlanMagic = 0x5A4E4E31;  //"ZNN1"
constexpr uint32_t kPlanVersion = 3;

constexpr uint32_t kPlanModuleCompanion = 1u << 0;

constexpr size_t kPlanMaxModules = 32;
constexpr size_t kPlanMaxBytes = 32 * 1024;

constexpr size_t kChannelNameMax = 96;
constexpr size_t kCompanionTokenBytes = 16;

struct PlanString {
  uint32_t offset;
  uint32_t length;
};

struct PlanModule {
  int32_t fd;
  uint32_t flags;
  uint32_t index;
  PlanString path;
};

struct Plan {
  uint32_t magic;
  uint32_t version;
  uint32_t size;
  uint32_t module_count;
  uint32_t nonce;
  uint8_t token[kCompanionTokenBytes];
  PlanString inline_engine;
  PlanString plt_engine;
  PlanString debugdata;
};

constexpr size_t kPlanHeaderSize = sizeof(Plan);
constexpr size_t kPlanModuleSize = sizeof(PlanModule);

static_assert(kPlanHeaderSize == 60, "the boot plan header must stay 60 bytes");
static_assert(kPlanModuleSize == 20, "a boot plan module must stay 20 bytes");

size_t channelName(uint32_t nonce, uint32_t index, char* out);
size_t directChannelName(uint32_t nonce, uint32_t index, char* out);

}  // namespace znn::ipc
```

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "module/loader.h"

#include <dlfcn.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include "api/api.h"
#include "ipc/channel.h"
#include "log.h"
#include "module/handle.h"
#include "utils/dlext.h"
#include "utils/elf_util.h"

namespace znn::module {
namespace {

int openCompanionChannel(const Plan& plan, const PlanModule& module) {
  const int fd = ipc::bindChannel(plan.nonce, module.index);
  if (fd < 0) {
    LOGE("module %s: cannot open its companion channel", module.path.c_str());
  }
  return fd;
}

void loadEntry(const Plan& plan, const PlanModule& entry) {
  const long page_size = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
  if (page_size > 0) {
    size_t min_align = 0;
    if (!elfLoadSegmentsFitPageSize(entry.fd, static_cast<size_t>(page_size),
                                    &min_align) &&
        min_align != 0) {
      LOGW(
          "%s is ELF-aligned to %zu bytes, but this process uses %ld-byte "
          "pages; rebuild it with -Wl,-z,max-page-size=%ld",
          entry.path.c_str(), min_align, page_size, page_size);
    }
  }

  void* lib = dlopenFd(entry.fd, entry.path.c_str(), RTLD_NOW);
  if (!lib) {
    LOGE("dlopen %s (fd %d) failed: %s", entry.path.c_str(), entry.fd,
         dlerror());
    close(entry.fd);
    return;
  }
  close(entry.fd);

  auto* m = reinterpret_cast<ZygiskNextModule*>(dlsym(lib, "zn_module"));
  if (!m || !m->onModuleLoaded) {
    LOGE("%s does not export zn_module", entry.path.c_str());
    return;
  }
  if (m->target_api_version < 1 ||
      m->target_api_version > ZYGISK_NEXT_API_VERSION) {
    LOGW("%s declares API version %d, which is not supported",
         entry.path.c_str(), m->target_api_version);
    return;
  }

  auto* handle = new ModuleHandle();
  handle->lib_path = entry.path;

  if (entry.companion) {
    handle->has_companion = true;
    handle->companion_nonce = plan.nonce;
    handle->companion_index = entry.index;
    memcpy(handle->companion_token, plan.token,
           sizeof(handle->companion_token));
    handle->companion_listen_fd = openCompanionChannel(plan, entry);
  }

  LOGI("loading module %s (companion=%s, api=%d)", entry.path.c_str(),
       entry.companion ? "yes" : "no", m->target_api_version);
  m->onModuleLoaded(handle, api::apiForVersion(m->target_api_version));
}

}  // namespace

void loadAll(const Plan& plan) {
  LOGI("loading %zu module(s) from the boot plan", plan.modules.size());
  for (const auto& entry : plan.modules) loadEntry(plan, entry);
}

}  // namespace znn::module
```
