```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "module/plan.h"

#include <string.h>

#include "ipc/plan.h"
#include "log.h"

namespace znn::module {
namespace {

constexpr size_t kMinPlanBytes = sizeof(ipc::Plan);

bool blobString(const char* blob, size_t blob_size, ipc::PlanString ref,
                std::string& out) {
  if (ref.length == 0) return true;
  const size_t offset = ref.offset;
  const size_t length = ref.length;
  if (offset > blob_size || length > blob_size - offset) return false;
  const size_t end = offset + length;
  if (end >= blob_size) return false;
  if (blob[end] != '\0') return false;
  out.assign(blob + offset, length);
  return true;
}

}  // namespace

bool parsePlan(const void* raw, Plan& out) {
  if (!raw) return false;

  ipc::Plan header{};
  memcpy(&header, raw, sizeof(header));
  if (header.magic != ipc::kPlanMagic) {
    LOGE("boot plan: bad magic %#x", header.magic);
    return false;
  }
  if (header.version != ipc::kPlanVersion) {
    LOGE("boot plan: unsupported version %u", header.version);
    return false;
  }
  if (header.size < kMinPlanBytes || header.size > ipc::kPlanMaxBytes) {
    LOGE("boot plan: implausible size %u", header.size);
    return false;
  }
  if (header.module_count > ipc::kPlanMaxModules) {
    LOGE("boot plan: %u modules is more than we accept", header.module_count);
    return false;
  }

  const size_t records =
      static_cast<size_t>(header.module_count) * ipc::kPlanModuleSize;
  if (kMinPlanBytes + records > header.size) {
    LOGE("boot plan: %u modules do not fit in %u bytes", header.module_count,
         header.size);
    return false;
  }

  const auto* base = static_cast<const char*>(raw);
  const char* blob = base + kMinPlanBytes + records;
  const size_t blob_size = header.size - kMinPlanBytes - records;

  out = Plan();
  out.nonce = header.nonce;
  memcpy(out.token, header.token, sizeof(out.token));
  if (!blobString(blob, blob_size, header.inline_engine, out.inline_engine) ||
      !blobString(blob, blob_size, header.plt_engine, out.plt_engine) ||
      !blobString(blob, blob_size, header.debugdata, out.debugdata)) {
    LOGE("boot plan: option names are out of bounds");
    return false;
  }

  const auto* mods =
      reinterpret_cast<const ipc::PlanModule*>(base + kMinPlanBytes);
  out.modules.reserve(header.module_count);
  for (uint32_t i = 0; i < header.module_count; ++i) {
    PlanModule m;
    m.fd = mods[i].fd;
    m.companion = (mods[i].flags & ipc::kPlanModuleCompanion) != 0;
    m.index = mods[i].index;
    if (m.fd < 0) {
      LOGE("boot plan: module %u has no library descriptor", i);
      return false;
    }
    if (m.index >= ipc::kPlanMaxModules) {
      LOGE("boot plan: module %u has an implausible index %u", i, m.index);
      return false;
    }
    if (!blobString(blob, blob_size, mods[i].path, m.path)) {
      LOGE("boot plan: module %u path is out of bounds", i);
      return false;
    }
    out.modules.push_back(std::move(m));
  }
  return true;
}

}  // namespace znn::module
```

```h
/*
```

```cpp
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "process/self.h"

#include <limits.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <unistd.h>

namespace znn::process {

std::string exePath() {
  char buf[PATH_MAX];
  ssize_t n = readlink("/proc/self/exe", buf, sizeof(buf) - 1);
  if (n <= 0) return {};
  std::string p(buf, static_cast<size_t>(n));
  constexpr char kDeleted[] = " (deleted)";
  constexpr size_t kDeletedLen = sizeof(kDeleted) - 1;
  if (p.size() > kDeletedLen &&
      p.compare(p.size() - kDeletedLen, kDeletedLen, kDeleted) == 0) {
    p.resize(p.size() - kDeletedLen);
  }
  return p;
}

std::string exeName() {
  const std::string p = exePath();
  const auto pos = p.rfind('/');
  return pos == std::string::npos ? p : p.substr(pos + 1);
}

}  // namespace znn::process
```

`loader/src/utils/debugdata.cpp`:

```cpp
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "debugdata.h"

#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>

#include <algorithm>
#include <mutex>

#include "LzmaDec.h"
#include "xz.h"

namespace znn::debugdata {
namespace {

constexpr size_t kMaxDecompressedSize = 64u * 1024u * 1024u;

constexpr uint32_t kMaxDictionarySize = 64u * 1024u * 1024u;

constexpr size_t kInitialOutputSize = 256u * 1024u;

constexpr uint8_t kXzMagic[] = {0xFD, '7', 'z', 'X', 'Z', 0x00};

Backend g_backend = Backend::kLzma;

std::once_flag g_crc_tables;

void ensureCrcTables() {
  std::call_once(g_crc_tables, [] {
    xz_crc32_init();
#ifdef XZ_USE_CRC64
    xz_crc64_init();
#endif
  });
}

bool isXzStream(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) {
  return size >= sizeof(kXzMagic) &&
         memcmp(data, kXzMagic, sizeof(kXzMagic)) == 0;
}

void* lzmaAlloc(ISzAllocPtr, size_t size) { return malloc(size); }

void lzmaFree(ISzAllocPtr, void* address) { free(address); }

const ISzAlloc g_lzma_alloc = {lzmaAlloc, lzmaFree};

bool lzmaAlone(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
  if (size < 13 || isXzStream(data, size)) return false;

  uint64_t declared_size = 0;
  for (int i = 0; i < 8; ++i)
    declared_size |= static_cast<uint64_t>(data[5 + i]) << (8 * i);

  const bool sized = declared_size != 0 && declared_size != UINT64_MAX;
  if (sized && declared_size > kMaxDecompressedSize) return false;

  const uint8_t* payload = data + 13;
  const size_t payload_size = size - 13;

  size_t capacity =
      sized ? static_cast<size_t>(declared_size) : kInitialOutputSize;
  while (true) {
    out.resize(capacity);

    SizeT dest_len = capacity;
    SizeT src_len = payload_size;
    ELzmaStatus status;

    const SRes result = LzmaDecode(
        out.data(), &dest_len, payload, &src_len, data, 5,
        sized ? LZMA_FINISH_END : LZMA_FINISH_ANY, &status, &g_lzma_alloc);
    if (result != SZ_OK) return false;

    if (status == LZMA_STATUS_FINISHED_WITH_MARK ||
        status == LZMA_STATUS_MAYBE_FINISHED_WITHOUT_MARK) {
      out.resize(dest_len);
      return true;
    }

    if (sized || capacity >= kMaxDecompressedSize) return false;
    capacity = std::min(capacity * 2, kMaxDecompressedSize);
  }
}

bool xzStream(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
  if (!isXzStream(data, size)) return false;

  ensureCrcTables();

  xz_dec* state = xz_dec_init(XZ_DYNALLOC, kMaxDictionarySize);
  if (!state) return false;

  out.resize(kInitialOutputSize);

  xz_buf buffer{};
  buffer.in = data;
  buffer.in_size = size;
  buffer.out = out.data();
  buffer.out_size = out.size();

  bool done = false;
  while (true) {
    const xz_ret result = xz_dec_run(state, &buffer);
    if (result == XZ_STREAM_END) {
      out.resize(buffer.out_pos);
      done = true;
      break;
    }
    if (result != XZ_OK || buffer.in_pos == buffer.in_size) break;
    if (buffer.out_pos < buffer.out_size) break;
    if (out.size() >= kMaxDecompressedSize) break;

    const size_t grown = std::min(out.size() * 2, kMaxDecompressedSize);
    out.resize(grown);
    buffer.out = out.data();
    buffer.out_size = grown;
  }

  xz_dec_end(state);
  return done;
}

bool tryBackend(Backend backend, const uint8_t* data, size_t size,
                std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
  return backend == Backend::kXz ? xzStream(data, size, out)
                                 : lzmaAlone(data, size, out);
}

}  // namespace

Backend backend() { return g_backend; }

void setBackend(Backend value) { g_backend = value; }

bool parseBackend(const char* name, Backend* out) {
  if (!name || !out) return false;
  if (strcmp(name, "lzma") == 0) {
    *out = Backend::kLzma;
  } else if (strcmp(name, "xz") == 0) {
    *out = Backend::kXz;
  } else {
    return false;
  }
  return true;
}

const char* backendName(Backend value) {
  return value == Backend::kXz ? "xz" : "lzma";
}

bool decompress(const uint8_t* data, size_t size, std::vector<uint8_t>& out) {
  out.clear();
  if (!data || size == 0) return false;

  const Backend preferred = backend();
  const Backend fallback =
      preferred == Backend::kXz ? Backend::kLzma : Backend::kXz;

  for (Backend candidate : {preferred, fallback}) {
    if (tryBackend(candidate, data, size, out)) return true;
    out.clear();
  }
  return false;
}

}  // namespace znn::debugdata
```

```h
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.

 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
```

```cpp
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

#include "utils/dlext.h"

#include <android/dlext.h>
#include <dlfcn.h>

#include "log.h"
#include "utils/elf_util.h"

namespace znn {
namespace {

using DlopenExtFn = void* (*)(const char*, int, const android_dlextinfo*);

DlopenExtFn resolveDlopenExt() {
  const char* linkers[] = {"linker64", "linker"};
  for (const char* linker : linkers) {
    const uintptr_t address =
        resolveLibrarySymbol(linker, "__loader_android_dlopen_ext");
    if (address != 0) return reinterpret_cast<DlopenExtFn>(address);
  }
  if (void* symbol = dlsym(RTLD_DEFAULT, "android_dlopen_ext")) {
    return reinterpret_cast<DlopenExtFn>(symbol);
  }
  return nullptr;
}

}  // namespace

void* dlopenFd(int fd, const char* name, int flags) {
  const DlopenExtFn dlopen_ext = resolveDlopenExt();
  if (!dlopen_ext) {
    LOGE("dlopen %s: this process has no android_dlopen_ext", name);
    return nullptr;
  }

  android_dlextinfo ext = {};
  ext.flags = ANDROID_DLEXT_USE_LIBRARY_FD;
  ext.library_fd = fd;
  return dlopen_ext(name, flags, &ext);
}

}  // namespace znn
```

```cpp
#include "elf_util.h"

#include <android/log.h>
#include <fcntl.h>
#include <inttypes.h>
#include <stdio.h>
#include <stdlib.h>
#include <string.h>
#include <sys/mman.h>
#include <sys/stat.h>
#include <sys/sysmacros.h>
#include <sys/types.h>
#include <unistd.h>

#include <cstring>
#include <mutex>
#include <unordered_set>

#include "debugdata.h"

#define ELF_LOGW(...) \
  __android_log_print(ANDROID_LOG_WARN, "znnloader", __VA_ARGS__)

namespace znn {

static bool isElf(const uint8_t* p, size_t size) {
  return size >= SELFMAG + 1 && p[EI_MAG0] == ELFMAG0 &&
         p[EI_MAG1] == ELFMAG1 && p[EI_MAG2] == ELFMAG2 &&
         p[EI_MAG3] == ELFMAG3;
}

static size_t runtimePageSize() {
  static const size_t size = [] {
    const long value = sysconf(_SC_PAGESIZE);
    return value > 0 ? static_cast<size_t>(value) : static_cast<size_t>(4096);
  }();
  return size;
}

static bool sectionInFile(const ElfW(Shdr) & sh, size_t file_size) {
  return sh.sh_offset <= file_size && sh.sh_size <= file_size - sh.sh_offset;
}

static bool sectionTableInFile(const ElfW(Ehdr) * ehdr, size_t file_size) {
  const size_t table_size =
      static_cast<size_t>(ehdr->e_shnum) * sizeof(ElfW(Shdr));
  const size_t table_offset = static_cast<size_t>(ehdr->e_shoff);
  if (table_offset > file_size) return false;
  return table_size <= file_size - table_offset;
}

static bool mapMatchesName(const MapEntry& m, const char* name) {
  if (m.path.empty() || m.path[0] == '[') return false;
  if (strchr(name, '/') != nullptr) return m.path == name;

  const char* slash = strrchr(m.path.c_str(), '/');
  return strcmp(slash ? slash + 1 : m.path.c_str(), name) == 0;
}

// soname or path, via maps
std::string resolveMapPath(const char* name) {
  for (const auto& m : parseMaps("self")) {
    if (mapMatchesName(m, name)) return m.path;
  }
  return {};
}

ElfImage::ElfImage(std::string path, uintptr_t base)
    : path_(std::move(path)), base_(base) {
  int fd = open(path_.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
  if (fd < 0) {
    std::string resolved = resolveMapPath(path_.c_str());
    if (resolved.empty()) return;
    path_ = std::move(resolved);
    fd = open(path_.c_str(), O_RDONLY | O_CLOEXEC);
    if (fd < 0) return;
  }

  struct stat st{};
  if (fstat(fd, &st) != 0 ||
      st.st_size < static_cast<off_t>(sizeof(ElfW(Ehdr)))) {
    close(fd);
    return;
  }
  file_size_ = static_cast<size_t>(st.st_size);

  if (base_ == 0) base_ = findLibraryBase(path_.c_str(), file_size_);

  file_ = static_cast<uint8_t*>(
      mmap(nullptr, file_size_, PROT_READ, MAP_PRIVATE, fd, 0));
  close(fd);
  if (file_ == MAP_FAILED) {
    file_ = nullptr;
    return;
  }

  ehdr_ = reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Ehdr)*>(file_);
  if (!isElf(file_, file_size_) || !sectionTableInFile(ehdr_, file_size_))
    return;

  is_dyn_ = (ehdr_->e_type == ET_DYN);
  if (!is_dyn_) {
    // ET_EXEC is loaded at its link-time addresses: there is no bias to add
    base_ = 0;
  } else if (base_ == 0) {
    return;
  } else if (memcmp(reinterpret_cast<const void*>(base_), ELFMAG, SELFMAG) !=
             0) {
    ELF_LOGW("ElfImage %s: base %p does not look like an ELF header",
             path_.c_str(), reinterpret_cast<void*>(base_));
    return;
  }

  if (ehdr_->e_shstrndx != SHN_UNDEF && ehdr_->e_shstrndx < ehdr_->e_shnum) {
    const ElfW(Shdr)* shdrs =
        reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Shdr)*>(file_ + ehdr_->e_shoff);
    const ElfW(Shdr)* shstr = &shdrs[ehdr_->e_shstrndx];
    if (sectionInFile(*shstr, file_size_))
      section_names_ = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(file_ + shstr->sh_offset);
  }

  valid_ = true;
}

ElfImage::~ElfImage() {
  if (file_) munmap(file_, file_size_);
}

void ElfImage::parseSymbols(const ElfW(Shdr) * str_sh, const char* strtab,
                            const ElfW(Sym) * symtab, size_t count,
                            uintptr_t bias) const {
  if (!strtab || !symtab) return;
  for (size_t i = 0; i < count; ++i) {
    const ElfW(Sym) & s = symtab[i];
    if (s.st_shndx == SHN_UNDEF) continue;
    if (s.st_name == 0) continue;
    if (s.st_name >= str_sh->sh_size) continue;
    const char* name = strtab + s.st_name;
    if (!name[0]) continue;

    SymbolInfo info;
    info.name = name;
    info.addr = bias + s.st_value;
    info.size = s.st_size;
    symbols_.push_back(std::move(info));
  }
}

bool ElfImage::parseGnuDebugData(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) const {
  for (size_t off : {static_cast<size_t>(4), static_cast<size_t>(0)}) {
    if (size <= off) continue;
    std::vector<uint8_t> out;
    if (!debugdata::decompress(data + off, size - off, out)) continue;
    if (!isElf(out.data(), out.size())) continue;

    debugdata_ = std::move(out);
    debugdata_ehdr_ = reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Ehdr)*>(debugdata_.data());
    return true;
  }
  return false;
}

void ElfImage::ensureParsed() const {
  std::lock_guard<std::mutex> lock(parse_mutex_);
  if (parsed_) return;
  parsed_ = true;

  const uintptr_t bias = is_dyn_ ? base_ : 0;
  const ElfW(Shdr)* shdrs =
      reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Shdr)*>(file_ + ehdr_->e_shoff);
  const size_t shnum = ehdr_->e_shnum;
  const size_t shstr_size =
      (ehdr_->e_shstrndx != SHN_UNDEF && ehdr_->e_shstrndx < shnum)
          ? shdrs[ehdr_->e_shstrndx].sh_size
          : 0;

  auto sec_name = [&](const ElfW(Shdr) & sh) -> const char* {
    if (!section_names_ || sh.sh_name >= shstr_size) return "";
    return section_names_ + sh.sh_name;
  };

  // walk section headers
  for (size_t i = 0; i < shnum; ++i) {
    const ElfW(Shdr) & sh = shdrs[i];

    if (sh.sh_type == SHT_SYMTAB || sh.sh_type == SHT_DYNSYM) {
      if (sh.sh_link >= shnum) continue;
      const ElfW(Shdr) & str_sh = shdrs[sh.sh_link];
      if (!sectionInFile(sh, file_size_) || !sectionInFile(str_sh, file_size_))
        continue;
      const char* strtab =
          reinterpret_cast<const char*>(file_ + str_sh.sh_offset);
      const ElfW(Sym)* symtab =
          reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Sym)*>(file_ + sh.sh_offset);
      if (sh.sh_entsize != sizeof(ElfW(Sym))) continue;
      size_t count = (sh.sh_entsize) ? sh.sh_size / sh.sh_entsize : 0;
      parseSymbols(&str_sh, strtab, symtab, count, bias);
    } else if (sh.sh_type == SHT_PROGBITS &&
               strcmp(sec_name(sh), ".gnu_debugdata") == 0 &&
               sectionInFile(sh, file_size_)) {
      parseGnuDebugData(file_ + sh.sh_offset, sh.sh_size);
    }
  }

  if (debugdata_ehdr_ &&
      sectionTableInFile(debugdata_ehdr_, debugdata_.size())) {
    const ElfW(Ehdr)* deh = debugdata_ehdr_;
    const ElfW(Shdr)* dshdrs =
        reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Shdr)*>(debugdata_.data() + deh->e_shoff);
    const size_t dshnum = deh->e_shnum;
    for (size_t i = 0; i < dshnum; ++i) {
      const ElfW(Shdr) & sh = dshdrs[i];
      if (sh.sh_type != SHT_SYMTAB) continue;
      if (sh.sh_link >= dshnum) continue;
      const ElfW(Shdr) & str_sh = dshdrs[sh.sh_link];
      if (!sectionInFile(sh, debugdata_.size()) ||
          !sectionInFile(str_sh, debugdata_.size())) {
        continue;
      }
      const char* strtab =
          reinterpret_cast<const char*>(debugdata_.data() + str_sh.sh_offset);
      const ElfW(Sym)* symtab =
          reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Sym)*>(debugdata_.data() + sh.sh_offset);
      if (sh.sh_entsize != sizeof(ElfW(Sym))) continue;
      size_t count = (sh.sh_entsize) ? sh.sh_size / sh.sh_entsize : 0;
      parseSymbols(&str_sh, strtab, symtab, count, bias);
    }
  }

  std::unordered_set<std::string> seen;
  std::vector<SymbolInfo> unique;
  unique.reserve(symbols_.size());
  for (auto& s : symbols_) {
    std::string key = s.name;
    key += '\0';
    key += std::to_string(s.addr);
    if (seen.insert(std::move(key)).second) unique.push_back(std::move(s));
  }
  symbols_ = std::move(unique);
}

const SymbolInfo* ElfImage::lookup(const char* name, bool prefix) const {
  ensureParsed();
  if (prefix) {
    size_t n = strlen(name);
    for (const auto& s : symbols_) {
      if (s.name.compare(0, n, name) == 0) return &s;
    }
  } else {
    for (const auto& s : symbols_) {
      if (s.name == name) return &s;
    }
  }
  return nullptr;
}

void ElfImage::forEach(
    const std::function<bool(const char*, uintptr_t, size_t)>& cb) const {
  ensureParsed();
  for (const auto& s : symbols_) {
    if (!cb(s.name.c_str(), s.addr, s.size)) break;
  }
}

uintptr_t ElfImage::runtimeLookup(const char* name, size_t* size) const {
  if (!base_ || !name) return 0;

  const ElfW(Ehdr)* eh = reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Ehdr)*>(base_);
  if (memcmp(eh->e_ident, ELFMAG, SELFMAG) != 0) return 0;
#if defined(__LP64__)
  if (eh->e_ident[EI_CLASS] != ELFCLASS64) return 0;
#else
  if (eh->e_ident[EI_CLASS] != ELFCLASS32) return 0;
#endif
  if (eh->e_ident[EI_DATA] != ELFDATA2LSB) return 0;

  const std::vector<MapEntry> maps = parseMaps("self");
  const auto mapEnd = [&maps](uintptr_t address) -> uintptr_t {
    for (const auto& map : maps) {
      if (address >= map.start && address < map.end) return map.end;
    }
    return 0;
  };

  const uint8_t* img = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(base_);
  const uintptr_t ph_address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(img + eh->e_phoff);
  const uintptr_t ph_map_end = mapEnd(ph_address);
  const size_t ph_size = static_cast<size_t>(eh->e_phnum) * sizeof(ElfW(Phdr));
  if (ph_map_end == 0 || ph_size > ph_map_end - ph_address) return 0;

  const ElfW(Phdr)* ph = reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Phdr)*>(ph_address);
  const ElfW(Dyn)* dyn = nullptr;
  for (int i = 0; i < eh->e_phnum; ++i) {
    if (ph[i].p_type == PT_DYNAMIC) {
      dyn = reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Dyn)*>(img + ph[i].p_vaddr);
      break;
    }
  }
  if (!dyn) return 0;

  const uintptr_t dyn_end = mapEnd(reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(dyn));
  if (dyn_end == 0) return 0;

  const ElfW(Sym)* symtab = nullptr;
  const char* strtab = nullptr;
  size_t strsz = 0;
  bool dyn_terminated = false;
  for (const ElfW(Dyn)* d = dyn;
       reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(d) + sizeof(ElfW(Dyn)) <= dyn_end; ++d) {
    if (d->d_tag == DT_NULL) {
      dyn_terminated = true;
      break;
    }
    switch (d->d_tag) {
      case DT_SYMTAB:
        symtab = reinterpret_cast<const ElfW(Sym)*>(img + d->d_un.d_ptr);
        break;
      case DT_STRTAB:
        strtab = reinterpret_cast<const char*>(img + d->d_un.d_ptr);
        break;
      case DT_STRSZ:
        strsz = static_cast<size_t>(d->d_un.d_val);
        break;
      default:
        break;
    }
  }
  if (!dyn_terminated || !symtab || !strtab || strsz == 0) return 0;

  const uintptr_t symtab_address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(symtab);
  const uintptr_t symtab_end = mapEnd(symtab_address);
  if (symtab_end == 0) return 0;
  size_t max_syms =
      static_cast<size_t>(symtab_end - symtab_address) / sizeof(ElfW(Sym));

  const uintptr_t strtab_address = reinterpret_cast<uintptr_t>(strtab);
  const uintptr_t strtab_end = mapEnd(strtab_address);
  if (strtab_end == 0) return 0;
  if (strtab_address > symtab_address) {
    const size_t distance =
        static_cast<size_t>(strtab_address - symtab_address) /
        sizeof(ElfW(Sym));
    if (distance < max_syms) max_syms = distance;
  }
  if (max_syms == 0) return 0;

  const size_t strtab_size = static_cast<size_t>(strtab_end - strtab_address);
  if (strsz > strtab_size) strsz = strtab_size;
  if (strsz == 0) return 0;

  const size_t name_len = strlen(name);
  for (size_t i = 1; i < max_syms; ++i) {
    const ElfW(Sym) & s = symtab[i];
    if (s.st_shndx == SHN_UNDEF || s.st_value == 0) continue;
    if (s.st_name == 0 || s.st_name >= strsz) continue;
    if (strsz - s.st_name <= name_len) continue;
    if (memcmp(strtab + s.st_name, name, name_len + 1) == 0) {
      if (size) *size = s.st_size;
      return base_ + s.st_value;
    }
  }
  return 0;
}

std::vector<MapEntry> parseMaps(const std::string& pid) {
  return parseMapsPath("/proc/" + pid + "/maps");
}

std::vector<MapEntry> parseMapsPath(const std::string& path) {
  std::vector<MapEntry> result;
  FILE* f = fopen(path.c_str(), "re");
  if (!f) return result;

  char* line = nullptr;
  size_t cap = 0;
  while (getline(&line, &cap, f) > 0) {
    uintptr_t start = 0, end = 0, offset = 0;
    unsigned int devmaj = 0, devmin = 0;
    unsigned long inode = 0;
    char perms[8] = {0};
    char mpath[512] = {0};
    int n = sscanf(
        line, "%" SCNxPTR "-%" SCNxPTR " %7s %" SCNxPTR " %x:%x %lu %511[^\n]",
        &start, &end, perms, &offset, &devmaj, &devmin, &inode, mpath);
    if (n < 7) continue;

    MapEntry e;
    e.start = start;
    e.end = end;
    e.offset = offset;
    e.dev = static_cast<dev_t>(makedev(devmaj, devmin));
    e.inode = static_cast<ino_t>(inode);
    e.is_private = (perms[3] == 'p');
    if (perms[0] == 'r') e.perms |= PROT_READ;
    if (perms[1] == 'w') e.perms |= PROT_WRITE;
    if (perms[2] == 'x') e.perms |= PROT_EXEC;
    e.path = mpath;
    result.push_back(std::move(e));
  }
  free(line);
  fclose(f);
  return result;
}

bool elfLoadSegmentsFitPageSize(int fd, size_t page_size, size_t* min_align) {
  ElfW(Ehdr) header{};
  if (pread(fd, &header, sizeof(header), 0) != sizeof(header)) return false;
  if (!isElf(reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t*>(&header), sizeof(header)))
    return false;
  if (header.e_phentsize != sizeof(ElfW(Phdr)) || header.e_phnum == 0 ||
      header.e_phnum > 4096) {
    return false;
  }

  size_t smallest = SIZE_MAX;
  for (ElfW(Half) i = 0; i < header.e_phnum; ++i) {
    ElfW(Phdr) phdr{};
    const off_t offset =
        static_cast<off_t>(header.e_phoff) +
        static_cast<off_t>(i) * static_cast<off_t>(sizeof(ElfW(Phdr)));
    if (pread(fd, &phdr, sizeof(phdr), offset) != sizeof(phdr)) return false;
    if (phdr.p_type != PT_LOAD || phdr.p_align <= 1) continue;
    if (static_cast<size_t>(phdr.p_align) < smallest)
      smallest = static_cast<size_t>(phdr.p_align);
  }
  if (smallest == SIZE_MAX) {
    if (min_align) *min_align = page_size;
    return true;
  }
  if (min_align) *min_align = smallest;
  return smallest >= page_size;
}

uintptr_t findLibraryBaseInMaps(const std::vector<MapEntry>& maps,
                                const char* name, size_t whole_size) {
  size_t matches = 0;
  for (const auto& m : maps) {
    if (mapMatchesName(m, name)) matches += 1;
  }

  for (const auto& m : maps) {
    if (!mapMatchesName(m, name)) continue;

    if (matches > 1 && whole_size != 0) {
      const uintptr_t span = m.end - m.start;
      if (span >= whole_size && span - whole_size < runtimePageSize()) continue;
    }

    if (m.start >= m.offset) return m.start - m.offset;
  }
  return 0;
}

uintptr_t findLibraryBase(const char* name, size_t whole_size) {
  return findLibraryBaseInMaps(parseMaps("self"), name, whole_size);
}

uintptr_t resolveLibrarySymbol(const char* lib_name, const char* symbol,
                               size_t* size) {
  ElfImage img(lib_name, 0);
  if (!img.valid()) return 0;
  const SymbolInfo* s = img.lookup(symbol, false);
  if (!s) return 0;
  if (size) *size = s->size;
  return s->addr;
}

}  // namespace znn
```

```h
#pragma once

#include <elf.h>
#include <link.h>

#include <cstddef>
#include <cstdint>
#include <functional>
#include <mutex>
#include <string>
#include <vector>

namespace znn {

struct SymbolInfo {
  std::string name;
  uintptr_t addr;
  size_t size;
};

class ElfImage {
 public:
  ElfImage(std::string path, uintptr_t base = 0);
  ~ElfImage();

  ElfImage(const ElfImage&) = delete;
  ElfImage& operator=(const ElfImage&) = delete;

  bool valid() const { return valid_; }
  uintptr_t base() const { return base_; }
  const std::string& path() const { return path_; }

  const SymbolInfo* lookup(const char* name, bool prefix) const;

  uintptr_t runtimeLookup(const char* name, size_t* size = nullptr) const;

  void forEach(
      const std::function<bool(const char*, uintptr_t, size_t)>& cb) const;

 private:
  void ensureParsed() const;
  void parseSymbols(const ElfW(Shdr) * str_sh, const char* strtab,
                    const ElfW(Sym) * symtab, size_t count,
                    uintptr_t bias) const;
  bool parseGnuDebugData(const uint8_t* data, size_t size) const;

  std::string path_;
  uintptr_t base_ = 0;
  bool valid_ = false;
  bool is_dyn_ = false;

  uint8_t* file_ = nullptr;
  size_t file_size_ = 0;
  const ElfW(Ehdr) * ehdr_ = nullptr;
  const char* section_names_ = nullptr;

  mutable std::vector<uint8_t> debugdata_;
  mutable const ElfW(Ehdr) * debugdata_ehdr_ = nullptr;

  mutable std::mutex parse_mutex_;
  mutable bool parsed_ = false;
  mutable std::vector<SymbolInfo> symbols_;
};

struct MapEntry {
  uintptr_t start = 0;
  uintptr_t end = 0;
  uintptr_t offset = 0;
  dev_t dev = 0;
  ino_t inode = 0;
  uint8_t perms = 0;
  bool is_private = false;
  std::string path;
};

std::vector<MapEntry> parseMaps(const std::string& pid);

std::vector<MapEntry> parseMapsPath(const std::string& path);

uintptr_t findLibraryBaseInMaps(const std::vector<MapEntry>& maps,
                                const char* name, size_t whole_size = 0);

bool elfLoadSegmentsFitPageSize(int fd, size_t page_size,
                                size_t* min_align = nullptr);

uintptr_t findLibraryBase(const char* name, size_t whole_size = 0);

uintptr_t resolveLibrarySymbol(const char* lib_name, const char* symbol,
                               size_t* size = nullptr);

}  // namespace znn
```

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import hashlib
import os
import re
import shutil
import string
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import build as znn

MODULE_DIR = ROOT / "module"
SOURCE_DIR = MODULE_DIR / "src"
STAGE_ROOT = MODULE_DIR / "build" / "outputs" / "module"
PRIVATE_KEY = MODULE_DIR / "private_key"
SIGNER = MODULE_DIR / "sign" / "Cargo.toml"

TEMPLATED_FILES = {"module.prop", "customize.sh", "late-load.sh", "post-fs-data.sh"}
SKIPPED_FILES = {*TEMPLATED_FILES, "mazoku"}

MACHIKADO_LAYOUT = {
    "machikado.arm64": ("arm64-v8a", "armeabi-v7a", "arm64-v8a"),
    "machikado.x64": ("x86_64", "x86", "x86_64"),
    "machikado.arm": ("armeabi-v7a", "armeabi-v7a", "arm64-v8a"),
    "machikado.x86": ("x86", "x86", "x86_64"),
    "machikado.riscv64": ("riscv64", "riscv64", "riscv64"),
}


def write_text(path, text):
    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    path.write_bytes(text.replace("\r\n", "\n").replace("\r", "\n").encode("utf-8"))


def sanitize_component(value):
    return re.sub(r"[^A-Z0-9]+", "_", value.upper()).strip("_")


def license_suffix(file_name):
    upper = file_name.upper()
    for prefix in ("LICENSE-", "LICENSE.", "COPYING-", "COPYING."):
        if upper.startswith(prefix):
            return sanitize_component(upper[len(prefix):])
    return ""


def prepare_licenses(stage):
    output = stage / "licenses"
    output.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    shutil.copyfile(ROOT / "LICENSE", output / "LICENSE-ZNNext")
    external = ROOT / "loader" / "src" / "external"
    licenses = []
    if external.is_dir():
        for component in external.iterdir():
            if not component.is_dir():
                continue
            for candidate in component.iterdir():
                if candidate.is_file() and re.match(
                    r"^(LICENSE|COPYING)([.-].*)?$", candidate.name
                ):
                    licenses.append(candidate)
    licenses.sort(key=lambda path: path.as_posix())

    used = {"LICENSE-ZNNext"}
    count = 1
    for license_file in licenses:
        component = sanitize_component(license_file.parent.name) or "EXTERNAL"
        suffix = license_suffix(license_file.name)
        base = f"LICENSE-{component}" + (f"-{suffix}" if suffix else "")
        target = base
        duplicate = 2
        while target in used:
            target = f"{base}-{duplicate}"
            duplicate += 1
        used.add(target)
        shutil.copyfile(license_file, output / target)
        count += 1
    print(f"licenses: packaged {count} files into licenses/", flush=True)


def copy_source_tree(stage):
    for path in sorted(SOURCE_DIR.rglob("*")):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        relative = path.relative_to(SOURCE_DIR).as_posix()
        if relative in SKIPPED_FILES:
            continue
        data = path.read_bytes()
        data = data.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n").replace(b"\r", b"\n")
        destination = stage / relative
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        destination.write_bytes(data)
        shutil.copymode(path, destination)


def expand_module_prop(stage, variant):
    contents = (SOURCE_DIR / "module.prop").read_text(encoding="utf-8")
    values = {
        "moduleId": znn.MODULE_ID,
        "moduleName": znn.MODULE_NAME,
        "versionName": (
            f"{znn.VER_NAME} ({znn.version_code()}-{znn.commit_hash()}-{variant})"
        ),
        "versionCode": str(znn.version_code()),
        "updateUrl": znn.UPDATE_URL,
    }
    write_text(stage / "module.prop", string.Template(contents).substitute(values))


def expand_scripts(stage, variant):
    tokens = {
        "DEBUG": "true" if variant == "debug" else "false",
        "MIN_SDK": str(znn.ANDROID_MIN_SDK),
        "MIN_KSU_VERSION": str(znn.MIN_KSU_VERSION),
        "MIN_KSUD_VERSION": str(znn.MIN_KSUD_VERSION),
        "MIN_MAGISK_VERSION": str(znn.MIN_MAGISK_VERSION),
        "MIN_APATCH_VERSION": str(znn.MIN_APATCH_VERSION),
        "KPM_ID": znn.KPM_ID,
    }
    for name in ("customize.sh", "late-load.sh", "post-fs-data.sh"):
        contents = (SOURCE_DIR / name).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        expanded = re.sub(
            r"@([A-Z0-9_]+)@",
            lambda match: tokens.get(match.group(1), match.group(0)),
            contents,
        )
        write_text(stage / name, expanded)


def copy_mazoku(stage):
    shutil.copy2(SOURCE_DIR / "mazoku", stage / "mazoku")


def copy_readme(stage):
    shutil.copy2(ROOT / "README.md", stage / "README.md")


def copy_webroot(stage):
    webroot = MODULE_DIR / "webroot"
    if not webroot.is_dir():
        print("webui: module/webroot is missing; the zip has no WebUI", flush=True)
        return
    for path in webroot.rglob("*"):
        if not path.is_file():
            continue
        relative = path.relative_to(webroot)
        destination = stage / "webroot" / relative
        destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        shutil.copy2(path, destination)


def copy_artifacts(stage, variant):
    for abi in znn.ANDROID_ABIS:
        loader = znn.loader_output(variant) / abi / "libzn_loader.so"
        if loader.is_file():
            destination = stage / "lib" / abi / "libzn_loader.so"
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(loader, destination)
        else:
            print(f"loader: missing {loader.relative_to(ROOT)}", file=sys.stderr)

        daemon = znn.daemon_output(variant) / abi / "znnd"
        if daemon.is_file():
            destination = stage / "bin" / abi / "znnd"
            destination.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            shutil.copy2(daemon, destination)
        else:
            print(f"daemon: missing {daemon.relative_to(ROOT)}", file=sys.stderr)


def copy_kpm(stage, variant, no_kpm):
    artifact = znn.kpm_output(variant) / "znn.kpm"
    if artifact.is_file():
        shutil.copy2(artifact, stage / "znn.kpm")
        print("kpm: packaging KernelPatch backend: znn.kpm", flush=True)
        return
    if no_kpm:
        print("kpm: disabled, the zip will not contain znn.kpm", file=sys.stderr)
        return
    raise znn.BuildError(
        "znn.kpm was not built; build with a complete NDK or pass --no-kpm"
    )


def sign_stage(stage):
    outputs = {"machikado.arm64", "machikado.x64", "machikado.arm", "machikado.x86", "machikado.riscv64"}
    if not PRIVATE_KEY.is_file():
        print("no private_key found, this build will not be signed", flush=True)
        for name in outputs:
            (stage / name).write_bytes(b"")
        return

    lines = []
    for output, (abi, abi32, abi64) in MACHIKADO_LAYOUT.items():
        entries = [
            ("module.prop.orig", "module.prop"),
            ("post-fs-data.sh", "post-fs-data.sh"),
            ("late-load.sh", "late-load.sh"),
            ("emulated-soft-reboot.sh", "emulated-soft-reboot.sh"),
            ("sepolicy.rule", "sepolicy.rule"),
            ("mazoku", "mazoku"),
            ("bin/znnd", f"bin/{abi}/znnd"),
            ("lib/libzn_loader.so", f"lib/{abi32}/libzn_loader.so"),
            ("lib64/libzn_loader.so", f"lib/{abi64}/libzn_loader.so"),
        ]
        for target, source in entries:
            lines.append(f"{output}\t{target}\t{source}")
        webroot = stage / "webroot"
        if webroot.is_dir():
            for path in sorted(webroot.rglob("*")):
                if path.is_file():
                    relative = path.relative_to(stage).as_posix()
                    lines.append(f"{output}\t{relative}\t{relative}")

    jobs_file = MODULE_DIR / "build" / "sign-jobs.txt"
    jobs_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    jobs_file.write_text("\n".join(lines) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")

    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment["CARGO_TARGET_DIR"] = str(MODULE_DIR / "build" / "sign-target")
    znn.run(
        [
            "cargo",
            "run",
            "--quiet",
            "--release",
            "--locked",
            "--manifest-path",
            str(SIGNER),
            "--",
            str(stage),
            str(PRIVATE_KEY),
            str(jobs_file),
        ],
        cwd=ROOT,
        env=environment,
        prefix="sign",
    )
    for name in outputs:
        path = stage / name
        if not path.is_file() or path.stat().st_size != 96:
            raise znn.BuildError(f"signer produced no valid {name}")


def write_checksums(stage):
    files = sorted(path for path in stage.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
    for path in files:
        digest = hashlib.sha256()
        with path.open("rb") as stream:
            for block in iter(lambda: stream.read(1024 * 1024), b""):
                digest.update(block)
        path.with_name(path.name + ".sha256").write_text(
            digest.hexdigest(), encoding="ascii"
        )
    print(f"checksums: wrote {len(files)} sha256 files", flush=True)


def build_zip(stage, variant, sevenzip_path):
    archive = znn.zip_path(variant)
    archive.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    if archive.exists():
        archive.unlink()

    files = sorted(
        path.relative_to(stage).as_posix() for path in stage.rglob("*") if path.is_file()
    )
    deflated = [
        name
        for name in files
        if (stage / name).stat().st_size < znn.XZ_MIN_ENTRY_SIZE
    ]
    xz = [
        name
        for name in files
        if (stage / name).stat().st_size >= znn.XZ_MIN_ENTRY_SIZE
    ]

    for method, members in (("Deflate", deflated), ("XZ", xz)):
        if not members:
            continue
        znn.run(
            [
                sevenzip_path,
                "a",
                "-tzip",
                "-mx=9",
                f"-mm={method}",
                "-bso0",
                "-bsp0",
                str(archive),
                *members,
            ],
            cwd=stage,
            prefix="zip",
        )

    if not archive.is_file():
        raise znn.BuildError(f"7-Zip produced no archive at {archive}")
    print(
        f"{archive.name}: {archive.stat().st_size} bytes "
        f"({len(xz)} xz + {len(deflated)} deflate entries)",
        flush=True,
    )
    return archive


def package(variant, no_kpm, sevenzip=None):
    stage = STAGE_ROOT / variant
    shutil.rmtree(stage, ignore_errors=True)
    stage.mkdir(parents=True)

    copy_source_tree(stage)
    copy_mazoku(stage)
    expand_module_prop(stage, variant)
    expand_scripts(stage, variant)
    copy_readme(stage)
    copy_webroot(stage)
    prepare_licenses(stage)
    copy_artifacts(stage, variant)
    copy_kpm(stage, variant, no_kpm)
    sign_stage(stage)
    write_checksums(stage)
    return build_zip(stage, variant, znn.seven_zip(sevenzip))


def push(variant):
    archive = znn.zip_path(variant)
    if not archive.is_file():
        raise znn.BuildError(f"{archive.relative_to(ROOT)} does not exist; build it first")
    znn.run(["adb", "push", str(archive), "/data/local/tmp"], prefix="adb")
    return archive


def install_ksu(variant):
    archive = push(variant)
    remote = f"/data/local/tmp/{archive.name}"
    znn.run(
        [
            "adb",
            "shell",
            f"echo '/data/adb/ksud module install {remote}' > /data/local/tmp/install.sh",
        ],
        prefix="adb",
    )
    znn.run(
        ["adb", "shell", "chmod", "755", "/data/local/tmp/install.sh"],
        prefix="adb",
    )
    znn.run(
        ["adb", "shell", "su", "-c", "/data/local/tmp/install.sh"],
        prefix="adb",
    )


def install_magisk(variant):
    archive = push(variant)
    remote = f"/data/local/tmp/{archive.name}"
    znn.run(
        ["adb", "shell", "su", "-M", "-c", f"magisk --install-module {remote}"],
        prefix="adb",
    )


def reboot():
    znn.run(["adb", "reboot"], prefix="adb")


def parse_arguments(argv):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="module/build.py")
    subparsers = parser.add_subparsers(dest="command", required=True)

    package_parser = subparsers.add_parser("package")
    package_parser.add_argument("variant", choices=znn.VARIANTS)
    package_parser.add_argument("--no-kpm", action="store_true")
    package_parser.add_argument("--sevenzip", default=None)

    for name in (
        "push",
        "install-ksu",
        "install-magisk",
        "install-ksu-reboot",
        "install-magisk-reboot",
    ):
        command_parser = subparsers.add_parser(name)
        command_parser.add_argument("variant", choices=znn.VARIANTS)
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv=None):
    options = parse_arguments(argv)
    if options.command == "package":
        package(options.variant, options.no_kpm, options.sevenzip)
    elif options.command == "push":
        push(options.variant)
    elif options.command == "install-ksu":
        install_ksu(options.variant)
    elif options.command == "install-magisk":
        install_magisk(options.variant)
    elif options.command == "install-ksu-reboot":
        install_ksu(options.variant)
        reboot()
    elif options.command == "install-magisk-reboot":
        install_magisk(options.variant)
        reboot()
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except znn.BuildError as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)
```

`module/sign/src/main.rs`:

```rs
use std::collections::BTreeMap;
use std::env;
use std::fs;
use std::io;
use std::path::Path;

use machikado_rs::{FileEntry, sign_file_entries};

fn main() -> Result<(), Box<dyn std::error::Error>> {
    let arguments: Vec<String> = env::args().collect();
    if arguments.len() != 4 {
        return Err(invalid("usage: znn-sign <root> <private-key> <jobs>").into());
    }

    let root = Path::new(&arguments[1]);
    let key = fs::read(&arguments[2])?;
    if key.len() != 64 {
        return Err(invalid(&format!(
            "private key must be 64 bytes, found {}",
            key.len()
        ))
        .into());
    }
    let key: [u8; 64] = key.try_into().map_err(|_| invalid("invalid private key"))?;

    let jobs = fs::read_to_string(&arguments[3])?;
    let mut groups: BTreeMap<String, Vec<FileEntry>> = BTreeMap::new();
    for (index, line) in jobs.lines().enumerate() {
        if line.is_empty() {
            continue;
        }
        let mut fields = line.split('\t');
        let output = fields
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid(&format!("line {}: missing output", index + 1)))?;
        let target = fields
            .next()
            .ok_or_else(|| invalid(&format!("line {}: missing target", index + 1)))?;
        let source = fields.next().unwrap_or("");
        let source = if source.is_empty() { target } else { source };
        if fields.next().is_some() {
            return Err(invalid(&format!("line {}: too many fields", index + 1)).into());
        }
        let content = fs::read(root.join(source))?;
        groups
            .entry(output.to_string())
            .or_default()
            .push(FileEntry {
                relative_path: target.to_string(),
                content,
            });
    }

    for (output, mut entries) in groups {
        entries.sort_by(|a, b| a.relative_path.cmp(&b.relative_path));
        let blob = sign_file_entries(&entries, &key)?;
        fs::write(root.join(output), blob.as_bytes())?;
    }

    Ok(())
}

fn invalid(message: &str) -> io::Error {
    io::Error::new(io::ErrorKind::InvalidInput, message)
}

```

```
#!/sbin/sh

#################
# Initialization
#################

umask 022

# echo before loading util_functions
ui_print() { echo "$1"; }

require_new_magisk() {
  ui_print "*******************************"
  ui_print " Please install Magisk v19.0+! "
  ui_print "*******************************"
  exit 1
}

#########################
# Load util_functions.sh
#########################

OUTFD=$2
ZIPFILE=$3

mount /data 2>/dev/null

[ -f /data/adb/magisk/util_functions.sh ] || require_new_magisk
. /data/adb/magisk/util_functions.sh
[ $MAGISK_VER_CODE -lt 19000 ] && require_new_magisk

if [ $MAGISK_VER_CODE -ge 20400 ]; then
  # New Magisk have complete installation logic within util_functions.sh
  install_module
  exit 0
fi

#################
# Legacy Support
#################

TMPDIR=/dev/tmp
PERSISTDIR=/sbin/.magisk/mirror/persist

is_legacy_script() {
  unzip -l "$ZIPFILE" install.sh | grep -q install.sh
  return $?
}

print_modname() {
  local len
  len=`echo -n $MODNAME | wc -c`
  len=$((len + 2))
  local pounds=`printf "%${len}s" | tr ' ' '*'`
  ui_print "$pounds"
  ui_print " $MODNAME "
  ui_print "$pounds"
  ui_print "*******************"
  ui_print " Powered by Magisk "
  ui_print "*******************"
}

# Override abort as old scripts have some issues
abort() {
  ui_print "$1"
  $BOOTMODE || recovery_cleanup
  [ -n $MODPATH ] && rm -rf $MODPATH
  rm -rf $TMPDIR
  exit 1
}

rm -rf $TMPDIR 2>/dev/null
mkdir -p $TMPDIR

# Preperation for flashable zips
setup_flashable

# Mount partitions
mount_partitions

# Detect version and architecture
api_level_arch_detect

# Setup busybox and binaries
$BOOTMODE && boot_actions || recovery_actions

##############
# Preparation
##############

# Extract prop file
unzip -o "$ZIPFILE" module.prop -d $TMPDIR >&2
[ ! -f $TMPDIR/module.prop ] && abort "! Unable to extract zip file!"

$BOOTMODE && MODDIRNAME=modules_update || MODDIRNAME=modules
MODULEROOT=$NVBASE/$MODDIRNAME
MODID=`grep_prop id $TMPDIR/module.prop`
MODPATH=$MODULEROOT/$MODID
MODNAME=`grep_prop name $TMPDIR/module.prop`

# Create mod paths
rm -rf $MODPATH 2>/dev/null
mkdir -p $MODPATH

##########
# Install
##########

if is_legacy_script; then
  unzip -oj "$ZIPFILE" module.prop install.sh uninstall.sh 'common/*' -d $TMPDIR >&2

  # Load install script
  . $TMPDIR/install.sh

  # Callbacks
  print_modname
  on_install

  # Custom uninstaller
  [ -f $TMPDIR/uninstall.sh ] && cp -af $TMPDIR/uninstall.sh $MODPATH/uninstall.sh

  # Skip mount
  $SKIPMOUNT && touch $MODPATH/skip_mount

  # prop file
  $PROPFILE && cp -af $TMPDIR/system.prop $MODPATH/system.prop

  # Module info
  cp -af $TMPDIR/module.prop $MODPATH/module.prop

  # post-fs-data scripts
  $POSTFSDATA && cp -af $TMPDIR/post-fs-data.sh $MODPATH/post-fs-data.sh

  # service scripts
  $LATESTARTSERVICE && cp -af $TMPDIR/service.sh $MODPATH/service.sh

  ui_print "- Setting permissions"
  set_permissions
else
  print_modname

  unzip -o "$ZIPFILE" customize.sh -d $MODPATH >&2

  if ! grep -q '^SKIPUNZIP=1$' $MODPATH/customize.sh 2>/dev/null; then
    ui_print "- Extracting module files"
    unzip -o "$ZIPFILE" -x 'META-INF/*' -d $MODPATH >&2

    # Default permissions
    set_perm_recursive $MODPATH 0 0 0755 0644
  fi

  # Load customization script
  [ -f $MODPATH/customize.sh ] && . $MODPATH/customize.sh
fi

# Handle replace folders
for TARGET in $REPLACE; do
  ui_print "- Replace target: $TARGET"
  mktouch $MODPATH$TARGET/.replace
done

if $BOOTMODE; then
  # Update info for Magisk Manager
  mktouch $NVBASE/modules/$MODID/update
  cp -af $MODPATH/module.prop $NVBASE/modules/$MODID/module.prop
fi

# Copy over custom sepolicy rules
if [ -f $MODPATH/sepolicy.rule -a -e $PERSISTDIR ]; then
  ui_print "- Installing custom sepolicy patch"
  PERSISTMOD=$PERSISTDIR/magisk/$MODID
  mkdir -p $PERSISTMOD
  cp -af $MODPATH/sepolicy.rule $PERSISTMOD/sepolicy.rule
fi

# Remove stuffs that don't belong to modules
rm -rf \
$MODPATH/system/placeholder $MODPATH/customize.sh \
$MODPATH/README.md $MODPATH/.git* 2>/dev/null

#############
# Finalizing
#############

cd /
$BOOTMODE || recovery_cleanup
rm -rf $TMPDIR

ui_print "- Done"
exit 0
```

`module/src/verify.sh`:

```sh
TMPDIR_FOR_VERIFY="$TMPDIR/.vunzip"
mkdir "$TMPDIR_FOR_VERIFY"

abort_verify() {
  ui_print "*********************************************************"
  ui_print "! $1"
  ui_print "! This zip may be corrupted, please try downloading again"
  abort "*********************************************************"
}

# extract <zip> <file> <target dir> <junk paths>
extract() {
  zip=$1
  file=$2
  dir=$3
  junk_paths=$4
  [ -z "$junk_paths" ] && junk_paths=false
  opts="-o"
  [ $junk_paths = true ] && opts="-oj"

  file_path=""
  hash_path=""
  if [ $junk_paths = true ]; then
    file_path="$dir/$(basename "$file")"
    hash_path="$TMPDIR_FOR_VERIFY/$(basename "$file").sha256"
  else
    file_path="$dir/$file"
    hash_path="$TMPDIR_FOR_VERIFY/$file.sha256"
  fi

  unzip $opts "$zip" "$file" -d "$dir" >&2
  [ -f "$file_path" ] || abort_verify "$file not exists"

  unzip $opts "$zip" "$file.sha256" -d "$TMPDIR_FOR_VERIFY" >&2
  [ -f "$hash_path" ] || abort_verify "$file.sha256 not exists"

  (echo "$(cat "$hash_path")  $file_path" | sha256sum -c -s -) || abort_verify "Failed to verify $file"
  ui_print "- Verified $file" >&1
}

file="META-INF/com/google/android/update-binary"
file_path="$TMPDIR_FOR_VERIFY/$file"
hash_path="$file_path.sha256"
unzip -o "$ZIPFILE" "META-INF/com/google/android/*" -d "$TMPDIR_FOR_VERIFY" >&2
[ -f "$file_path" ] || abort_verify "$file not exists"
if [ -f "$hash_path" ]; then
  (echo "$(cat "$hash_path")  $file_path" | sha256sum -c -s -) || abort_verify "Failed to verify $file"
  ui_print "- Verified $file" >&1
else
  ui_print "- Download from Magisk app"
fi

```

`webui/build.py`:

```py
#!/usr/bin/env python3
import argparse
import os
import shutil
import sys
from pathlib import Path

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT))
import build as znn

WEBUI_DIR = ROOT / "webui"
WEBROOT = ROOT / "module" / "webroot"


def npm_executable():
    executable = shutil.which("npm")
    if not executable:
        raise znn.BuildError("npm was not found on PATH")
    return executable


def install_needed():
    node_modules = WEBUI_DIR / "node_modules"
    marker = node_modules / ".package-lock.json"
    if not node_modules.is_dir() or not marker.is_file():
        return True
    lock = WEBUI_DIR / "package-lock.json"
    return lock.is_file() and lock.stat().st_mtime > marker.stat().st_mtime


def install(force):
    if not force and not install_needed():
        print("webui: npm dependencies are up to date", flush=True)
        return
    npm = npm_executable()
    command = [npm, "ci" if (WEBUI_DIR / "package-lock.json").is_file() else "install"]
    command += ["--no-audit", "--no-fund"]
    znn.run(command, cwd=WEBUI_DIR, prefix="webui")


def parse_arguments(argv):
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(prog="webui/build.py")
    parser.add_argument("--force-install", action="store_true")
    parser.add_argument("--skip-install", action="store_true")
    return parser.parse_args(argv)


def main(argv=None):
    options = parse_arguments(argv)
    if not options.skip_install:
        install(options.force_install)
    npm = npm_executable()
    environment = os.environ.copy()
    environment["ZNN_MODULE_ID"] = znn.MODULE_ID
    environment["ZNN_MODULE_NAME"] = znn.MODULE_NAME
    environment["ZNN_VER_NAME"] = znn.VER_NAME
    environment["ZNN_COMMIT_HASH"] = znn.commit_hash()
    znn.run([npm, "run", "build"], cwd=WEBUI_DIR, env=environment, prefix="webui")
    if not (WEBROOT / "index.html").is_file():
        raise znn.BuildError(f"webui produced no index.html at {WEBROOT}")
    print(f"webui: built {WEBROOT.relative_to(ROOT)}", flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    try:
        sys.exit(main())
    except znn.BuildError as error:
        print(f"error: {error}", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

```

```js
(function () {
  if (window.ksu) return;

  var params = new URLSearchParams(location.search);

  var theme = params.get('theme');
  if (theme === 'light' || theme === 'dark' || theme === 'auto') {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('znn_theme', theme);
    } catch (error) {}
  }

  var locale = params.get('locale');
  if (locale === 'en' || locale === 'zh-CN') {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('znn_locale', locale);
    } catch (error) {}
  }

  var ui = params.get('ui');
  if (ui === 'material' || ui === 'miuix' || ui === 'zn') {
    try {
      localStorage.setItem('znn_ui', ui);
    } catch (error) {}
  }

  if (params.get('ksu') === '0') return;

  var latency = Number(params.get('slow') || 120);
  var failures = (params.get('fail') || '').split(',').filter(Boolean);
  var pid = function () {
    return 300 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 9000);
  };

  var CONFIG_KEYS = {
    inline: 'inlineHook',
    inline32: 'inlineHook32',
    plt: 'pltHook',
    plt32: 'pltHook32',
    mode: 'mode',
    debugdata: 'debugdata',
    'disable-zn': 'disableZn',
  };

  var config = {
    inlineHook: { value: 'dobby', options: ['dobby', 'shadowhook', 'and64inlinehook', 'frida-gum', 'rv64hook', 'hookzz', 'urhook', 'whale', 'baaadhook', 'yukiihook', 'disable'] },
    inlineHook32: { value: 'dobby', options: ['dobby', 'shadowhook', 'frida-gum', 'hookzz', 'whale', 'baaadhook', 'disable'] },
    pltHook: { value: 'lsplt', options: ['lsplt', 'plti', 'bytehook', 'xhook', 'plthook', 'urhook', 'baaadhook', 'yukiplt', 'disable'] },
    pltHook32: { value: 'lsplt', options: ['lsplt', 'plti', 'bytehook', 'xhook', 'plthook', 'baaadhook', 'yukiplt', 'disable'] },
    mode: { value: 'proc', options: ['auto', 'kernel', 'ptrace', 'proc', 'late'] },
    debugdata: { value: 'lzma', options: ['lzma', 'xz'] },
    disableZn: { value: 'true', options: ['true', 'false'] },
  };

  var modules = [
    {
      id: 'zygisknextsu',
      name: 'ZNNext',
      version: 'v0.0.0',
      processes: [
        { pid: pid(), name: 'adbd' },
        { pid: pid(), name: 'netd' },
        { pid: pid(), name: 'artd' },
      ],
      failed: [],
    },
    {
      id: 'zygisk_lsposed',
      name: 'LSPosed',
      version: 'v1.9.2',
      processes: [
        { pid: pid(), name: 'artd' },
        { pid: pid(), name: 'hyos_spawner' },
      ],
      failed: [
        { name: 'artd', reason: 'test' },
        { name: 'hyos_spawner', reason: 'test' },
      ],
    },
  ];

  if (params.get('modules') === 'none') {
    modules = [];
  }

  var state = {
    running: params.get('status') !== 'inactive',
    mode: 'proc',
    config: config,
    modules: modules,
  };

  function snapshot(cmd, operands) {
    switch (cmd) {
      case 'status':
        return { running: state.running, pid: state.running ? 4242 : 0, mode: state.mode };
      case 'system':
        return {
          kernel: '5.15.148-android13-8-g2b4c1f0a1b2c-ab1234567',
          sdk: 34,
          abi: 'arm64-v8a',
          abilist: 'arm64-v8a,armeabi-v7a,armeabi',
          root: { magisk: null, kernelSU: 'ksud v3.0.0', apatch: null },
        };
      case 'modules':
        return state.modules;
      case 'config':
        return state.config;
      case 'config-set': {
        var kind = operands[0];
        var value = operands[1];
        var key = CONFIG_KEYS[kind];
        var entry = key ? state.config[key] : null;
        if (!entry) {
          throw new Error(
            'usage: znnd --ctl config-set <inline|inline32|plt|plt32|mode|debugdata|disable-zn> <value>',
          );
        }
        if (entry.options.indexOf(value) < 0) {
          throw new Error('invalid ' + kind + ' value "' + value + '" for this device');
        }
        entry.value = value;
        return state.config;
      }
      default:
        throw new Error('unknown command: ' + cmd);
    }
  }

  function splitCommand(command) {
    var tokens = [];
    var current = '';
    var quoted = false;
    var started = false;
    for (var i = 0; i < command.length; i++) {
      var ch = command.charAt(i);
      if (ch === '\\' && !quoted && i + 1 < command.length) {
        current += command.charAt(++i);
        started = true;
      } else if (ch === "'") {
        quoted = !quoted;
        started = true;
      } else if (!quoted && /\s/.test(ch)) {
        if (started) {
          tokens.push(current);
          current = '';
          started = false;
        }
      } else {
        current += ch;
        started = true;
      }
    }
    if (started) tokens.push(current);
    return tokens;
  }

  window.ksu = {
    exec: function (command, options, callbackName) {
      window.setTimeout(function () {
        var argc = splitCommand(command);
        var ctl = argc.indexOf('--ctl');
        var cmd = ctl >= 0 ? argc[ctl + 1] : '';
        var operands = ctl >= 0 ? argc.slice(ctl + 2) : [];
        if (failures.indexOf(cmd) >= 0) {
          window[callbackName](1, '', 'stub: forced failure for "' + cmd + '"');
          return;
        }
        try {
          window[callbackName](0, JSON.stringify(snapshot(cmd, operands)), '');
        } catch (error) {
          window[callbackName](1, '', String(error && error.message ? error.message : error));
        }
      }, latency);
    },
    moduleInfo: function () {
      return JSON.stringify({ moduleDir: '/data/adb/modules/zygisknextsu' });
    },
    toast: function (message) {
      console.info('[znn preview] toast:', message);
    },
    fullScreen: function () {},
    enableEdgeToEdge: function () {},
    listPackages: function () {
      return '[]';
    },
  };

  console.info(
    '[znn preview] KernelSU bridge stubbed. Overrides: ?ksu=0 ?status=inactive ?modules=none ' +
      '?ui=material|miuix|zn ?theme=light|dark|auto ?locale=zh-CN|en ?slow=MS ?fail=config,modules',
  );
})();
```

```html
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <meta
      name="viewport"
      content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, viewport-fit=cover"
    />
    <meta name="color-scheme" content="light dark" />
    <title>ZNNext</title>
    <style>
      html[data-znn-ui='miuix'][data-znn-scheme='light'] {
        background-color: #ffffff;
      }
      html[data-znn-ui='miuix'][data-znn-scheme='dark'] {
        background-color: #242424;
      }
      html[data-znn-ui='zn'][data-znn-scheme='light'] {
        background-color: #ffffff;
      }
      html[data-znn-ui='zn'][data-znn-scheme='dark'] {
        background-color: #101014;
      }
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <m3e-theme
      id="znn-theme"
      color="#6750a4"
      scheme="light"
      motion="expressive"
      density="-2"
    >
      <div id="app"></div>
    </m3e-theme>
    <script>
      (function () {
        var scheme = 'light';
        try {
          var saved = localStorage.getItem('znn_theme');
          if (saved === 'light' || saved === 'dark') {
            scheme = saved;
          } else if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-color-scheme: dark)').matches) {
            scheme = 'dark';
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        var ui = 'material';
        try {
          var savedUi = localStorage.getItem('znn_ui');
          if (savedUi === 'material' || savedUi === 'miuix' || savedUi === 'zn') {
            ui = savedUi;
          }
        } catch (e) {}
        var root = document.documentElement;
        root.dataset.znnScheme = scheme;
        root.dataset.znnUi = ui;
        root.style.colorScheme = scheme;
        if (scheme === 'dark') root.classList.add('m-theme-dark');
        var host = document.getElementById('znn-theme');
        if (host) host.setAttribute('scheme', scheme);
      })();
    </script>
    <script type="module" src="/src/main.ts"></script>
  </body>
</html>
```

`webui/src/api/config.ts`:

```ts
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

import { apiBinary, execJson, shellQuote } from "./ksu";

export interface HookEngineEntry {
  value: string;
  options: string[];
}

export interface HookConfig {
  inlineHook: HookEngineEntry;
  inlineHook32?: HookEngineEntry;
  pltHook: HookEngineEntry;
  pltHook32?: HookEngineEntry;
  mode: HookEngineEntry;
  debugdata: HookEngineEntry;
  disableZn: HookEngineEntry;
}

export type HookKind =
  "inline" | "inline32" | "plt" | "plt32" | "mode" | "debugdata" | "disable-zn";

function isHookEngineEntry(value: unknown): value is HookEngineEntry {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return false;
  const entry = value as { value?: unknown; options?: unknown };
  return (
    typeof entry.value === "string" &&
    Array.isArray(entry.options) &&
    entry.options.every((option) => typeof option === "string")
  );
}

interface LegacyHookConfig {
  inlineHook: HookEngineEntry;
  inlineHook32?: HookEngineEntry;
  pltHook: HookEngineEntry;
  pltHook32?: HookEngineEntry;
  mode: HookEngineEntry;
  debugdata: HookEngineEntry;
  disableZn?: HookEngineEntry;
}

const DEFAULT_DISABLE_ZN: HookEngineEntry = {
  value: "true",
  options: ["true", "false"],
};

function isHookConfig(value: unknown): value is LegacyHookConfig {
  if (typeof value !== "object" || value === null) return false;
  const config = value as Record<string, unknown>;
  return (
    isHookEngineEntry(config.inlineHook) &&
    (config.inlineHook32 === undefined ||
      isHookEngineEntry(config.inlineHook32)) &&
    isHookEngineEntry(config.pltHook) &&
    (config.pltHook32 === undefined || isHookEngineEntry(config.pltHook32)) &&
    isHookEngineEntry(config.mode) &&
    isHookEngineEntry(config.debugdata) &&
    (config.disableZn === undefined || isHookEngineEntry(config.disableZn))
  );
}

function parseHookConfig(raw: unknown): HookConfig {
  if (!isHookConfig(raw)) throw new Error("unexpected config response");
  return {
    inlineHook: raw.inlineHook,
    inlineHook32: raw.inlineHook32,
    pltHook: raw.pltHook,
    pltHook32: raw.pltHook32,
    mode: raw.mode,
    debugdata: raw.debugdata,
    disableZn: raw.disableZn ?? DEFAULT_DISABLE_ZN,
  };
}

export async function getHookConfig(): Promise<HookConfig> {
  return parseHookConfig(
    await execJson<unknown>(`${apiBinary()} --ctl config`),
  );
}

export async function setHookConfig(
  kind: HookKind,
  value: string,
): Promise<HookConfig> {
  return parseHookConfig(
    await execJson<unknown>(
      `${apiBinary()} --ctl config-set ${shellQuote(kind)} ${shellQuote(value)}`,
    ),
  );
}
```

```ts
import { apiBinary, execJson } from "./ksu";

export interface DaemonStatus {
  running: boolean;
  pid: number;
  mode?: string;
}

export async function getDaemonStatus(): Promise<DaemonStatus> {

  }>(`${apiBinary()} --ctl status`);
```

`webui/src/api/ksu.ts`:

```ts
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

import { exec, moduleInfo } from "kernelsu";
import { MODULE_ID } from "../app-info";

export function isKsuAvailable(): boolean {
  return typeof (window as unknown as { ksu?: unknown }).ksu !== "undefined";
}

export async function execJson<T>(
  command: string,
  timeoutMs = 5000,
): Promise<T> {
  let timer: ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | undefined;
  try {
    const result = await Promise.race([
      exec(command),
      new Promise<never>((_, reject) => {
        timer = setTimeout(
          () => reject(new Error(`command timed out: ${command}`)),
          timeoutMs,
        );
      }),
    ]);
    if (result.errno !== 0) {
      throw new Error(
        `command failed (errno ${result.errno}): ${command}\n${result.stderr}`,
      );
    }
    return JSON.parse(result.stdout.trim()) as T;
  } finally {
    if (timer !== undefined) {
      clearTimeout(timer);
    }
  }
}

export function getModuleDir(): string {
  try {
    const info = JSON.parse(moduleInfo()) as { moduleDir?: string };
    if (
      info &&
      typeof info.moduleDir === "string" &&
      info.moduleDir.length > 0
    ) {
      return info.moduleDir;
    }
  } catch {}
  return `/data/adb/modules/${MODULE_ID}`;
}

export function shellQuote(value: string): string {
  return `'${value.split("'").join("'\\''")}'`;
}

export function apiBinary(): string {
  return shellQuote(`${getModuleDir()}/bin/znnd`);
}
```

`webui/src/api/modules.ts`:

```ts
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

import { apiBinary, execJson } from "./ksu";

export interface InjectedProcess {
  pid: number;
  name: string;
}

export interface FailedProcess {
  name: string;
  reason: string;
}

export interface ZnnModule {
  id: string;
  name: string;
  version: string;
  processes: InjectedProcess[];
  failed?: FailedProcess[];
}

function normaliseProcesses(raw: unknown): InjectedProcess[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  const processes: InjectedProcess[] = [];
  for (const item of raw) {
    if (typeof item !== "object" || item === null) continue;
    const process = item as { pid?: unknown; name?: unknown };
    if (typeof process.pid !== "number" || typeof process.name !== "string")
      continue;
    processes.push({ pid: process.pid, name: process.name });
  }
  return processes;
}

function normaliseFailed(raw: unknown): FailedProcess[] {
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) return [];
  const failed: FailedProcess[] = [];
  for (const item of raw) {
    if (typeof item !== "object" || item === null) continue;
    const failure = item as { name?: unknown; reason?: unknown };
    if (typeof failure.name !== "string" || typeof failure.reason !== "string")
      continue;
    failed.push({ name: failure.name, reason: failure.reason });
  }
  return failed;
}

function normaliseModule(raw: unknown): ZnnModule | null {
  if (typeof raw !== "object" || raw === null) return null;
  const module = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
  if (
    typeof module.id !== "string" ||
    typeof module.name !== "string" ||
    typeof module.version !== "string"
  ) {
    return null;
  }
  return {
    id: module.id,
    name: module.name,
    version: module.version,
    processes: normaliseProcesses(module.processes),
    failed: normaliseFailed(module.failed),
  };
}

export async function getModules(): Promise<ZnnModule[]> {
  const raw = await execJson<unknown>(`${apiBinary()} --ctl modules`);
  if (!Array.isArray(raw)) throw new Error("unexpected modules response");
  const modules: ZnnModule[] = [];
  for (const item of raw) {
    const module = normaliseModule(item);
    if (module !== null) modules.push(module);
  }
  return modules;
}
```

`webui/src/api/system.ts`:

```ts
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

import { apiBinary, execJson } from "./ksu";

export interface RootImplementation {
  magisk: string | null;
  kernelSU: string | null;
  apatch: string | null;
}

export interface SystemInfo {
  kernel: string;
  sdk: number;
  abi: string;
  abilist: string;
  root: RootImplementation;
}

function asString(value: unknown): string {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : "";
}

function asRootString(value: unknown): string | null {
  return typeof value === "string" ? value : null;
}

export async function getSystemInfo(): Promise<SystemInfo> {
  const raw = await execJson<unknown>(`${apiBinary()} --ctl system`);
  const info =
    typeof raw === "object" && raw !== null
      ? (raw as Record<string, unknown>)
      : {};
  const root =
    typeof info.root === "object" && info.root !== null
      ? (info.root as Record<string, unknown>)
      : {};
  return {
    kernel: asString(info.kernel),
    sdk: typeof info.sdk === "number" ? info.sdk : 0,
    abi: asString(info.abi),
    abilist: asString(info.abilist),
    root: {
      magisk: asRootString(root.magisk),
      kernelSU: asRootString(root.kernelSU),
      apatch: asRootString(root.apatch),
    },
  };
}

export function cleanVersion(raw: string | null): string | null {
  if (!raw) return null;
  return (
    raw
      .replace(/^(ksud|apd|magisk)\s+/i, "")
      .replace(/^v/i, "")
      .trim() || null
  );
}
```

```ts
/*
```

`webui/src/composables/use-app-data.ts`:

```ts
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

import { ref, type Ref } from "vue";

import {
  getHookConfig,
  setHookConfig,
  type HookConfig,
  type HookKind,
} from "../api/config";
import { getDaemonStatus, type DaemonStatus } from "../api/daemon";
import { isKsuAvailable } from "../api/ksu";
import { getModules, type ZnnModule } from "../api/modules";
import { getSystemInfo, type SystemInfo } from "../api/system";

export interface AppData {
  ksuAvailable: boolean;
  status: Ref<DaemonStatus | null>;
  system: Ref<SystemInfo | null>;
  modules: Ref<ZnnModule[] | null>;
  config: Ref<HookConfig | null>;
  loading: Ref<boolean>;
  load: () => Promise<void>;
  applyHookConfig: (kind: HookKind, value: string) => Promise<void>;
}

export function useAppData(): AppData {
  const ksuAvailable = isKsuAvailable();
  const status = ref<DaemonStatus | null>(null);
  const system = ref<SystemInfo | null>(null);
  const modules = ref<ZnnModule[] | null>(null);
  const config = ref<HookConfig | null>(null);
  const loading = ref(ksuAvailable);
  let configGeneration = 0;
  let inFlight = false;

  async function load(): Promise<void> {
    if (!ksuAvailable || inFlight) return;
    inFlight = true;
    loading.value = true;
    const generation = configGeneration;
    try {
      const [nextStatus, nextSystem, nextModules, nextConfig] =
        await Promise.all([
          getDaemonStatus().catch((e) => {
            console.warn("[znn] status:", e);
            return null;
          }),
          getSystemInfo().catch((e) => {
            console.warn("[znn] system:", e);
            return null;
          }),
          getModules().catch((e) => {
            console.warn("[znn] modules:", e);
            return null;
          }),
          getHookConfig().catch((e) => {
            console.warn("[znn] config:", e);
            return null;
          }),
        ]);
      if (nextStatus !== null) status.value = nextStatus;
      if (nextSystem !== null) system.value = nextSystem;
      if (nextModules !== null) modules.value = nextModules;
      if (generation === configGeneration && nextConfig !== null)
        config.value = nextConfig;
    } finally {
      loading.value = false;
      inFlight = false;
    }
  }

  async function applyHookConfig(kind: HookKind, value: string): Promise<void> {
    configGeneration += 1;
    try {
      const nextConfig = await setHookConfig(kind, value);
      config.value = nextConfig;
    } finally {
      configGeneration += 1;
    }
  }

  return {
    ksuAvailable,
    status,
    system,
    modules,
    config,
    loading,
    load,
    applyHookConfig,
  };
}
```

```ts
import type { HookConfig, HookEngineEntry, HookKind } from "./api/config";
import { t } from "./i18n";

export const ENGINE_LABELS: Record<string, string> = {
  dobby: "Dobby",
  shadowhook: "ShadowHook",

  and64inlinehook: "And64InlineHook",

export const HOOK_ROWS: HookRow[] = [

  { kind: "plt", field: "pltHook", labelKey: "config.pltHook" },
  { kind: "plt32", field: "pltHook32", labelKey: "config.pltHook32" },
  { kind: "mode", field: "mode", labelKey: "config.mode" },
  { kind: "debugdata", field: "debugdata", labelKey: "config.debugdata" },
  { kind: "disable-zn", field: "disableZn", labelKey: "config.disableZn" },
];

export const UI_ROW_LABEL_KEY = "config.uiStyle";

export function configRows<T>(
  config: HookConfig,
  map: (row: HookRow, entry: HookEngineEntry) => T,
  uiRow: T,
): T[] {
  const upper: T[] = [];
  const lower: T[] = [];
  for (const row of HOOK_ROWS) {
    const entry = config[row.field];
    if (!entry) continue;
    (row.kind === "disable-zn" ? lower : upper).push(map(row, entry));
  }
  upper.push(uiRow);
  upper.push(...lower);
  return upper;
}

export function hookOptionLabel(kind: HookKind, id: string): string {
  if (kind === "mode") return t(`config.mode.${id}`);
  if (kind === "debugdata") return t(`config.debugdata.${id}`);
  if (kind === "disable-zn") return t(`config.disableZn.${id}`);
  return ENGINE_LABELS[id] ?? id;
}

export function uiModeLabel(mode: string): string {
  if (mode === "miuix") return t("ui.miuix");
  if (mode === "zn") return t("ui.zn");
  return t("ui.material");
}
```

```ts
/*
 * This file is part of ZNNext.
 *
 * ZNNext is free software: you can redistribute it and/or modify
 * it under the terms of the GNU General Public License as published by
 * the Free Software Foundation, either version 3 of the License, or
 * (at your option) any later version.
 *
 * ZNNext is distributed in the hope that it will be useful,
 * but WITHOUT ANY WARRANTY; without even the implied warranty of
 * MERCHANTABILITY or FITNESS FOR A PARTICULAR PURPOSE. See the
 * GNU General Public License for more details.
 *
 * You should have received a copy of the GNU General Public License
 * along with ZNNext. If not, see <https://www.gnu.org/licenses/>.
 *
 * Copyright (C) 2026 VeryBaaad <verybaaad@outlook.com>
 */

import { computed, ref, type ComputedRef } from "vue";

import { en, type Dictionary } from "./en";
import { zhCN } from "./zh-CN";
import { lzh } from "./lzh";

export type Locale = "lzh" | "zh-CN" | "en";

export const LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY = "znn_locale";

export const LOCALES: Locale[] = ["lzh", "zh-CN", "en"];

const dictionaries: Record<Locale, Dictionary> = {
  lzh: lzh,
  "zh-CN": zhCN,
  en,
};

export const LOCALE_LABELS: Record<Locale, string> = {
  lzh: "文言（華夏）",
  "zh-CN": "中文（简体）",
  en: "English",
};

const currentRef = ref<Locale>(detectLocale());

export const locale: ComputedRef<Locale> = computed(() => currentRef.value);

function detectLocale(): Locale {
  try {
    const saved = localStorage.getItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY);
    if (saved === "lzh" || saved === "zh-CN" || saved === "en") return saved;
  } catch {}
  const lang = (navigator.language || "en").toLowerCase();
  return lang.startsWith("zh") ? "zh-CN" : "en";
}

export function setLocale(next: Locale): void {
  if (next === currentRef.value) return;
  currentRef.value = next;
  try {
    localStorage.setItem(LOCALE_STORAGE_KEY, next);
  } catch {}
  applyLocale();
}

export function t(
  key: string,
  params?: Record<string, string | number>,
): string {
  const strings = dictionaries[currentRef.value] as Record<string, string>;
  let text: string = strings[key] ?? (en as Record<string, string>)[key] ?? key;
  if (params) {
    for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(params)) {
      text = text.split(`{${k}}`).join(String(v));
    }
  }
  return text;
}

export function applyLocale(): void {
  document.documentElement.lang = currentRef.value;
}
```
